31340.s: The bill amends the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 on several technical points, including creating a ministerial register of mobile objects other than bicycles, extending delegation for traffic controllers and vehicle maintenance requirements, and allowing exemptions for cash-transport firms. It also makes a technical change to the Wet bereikbaarheid en mobiliteit tied to an EU directive.
31340.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying implementing detail must follow at the level of an amvb or ministerial regulation, with costs to be mapped later.
q: Because delegation bases are provided, further elaboration must still take place at the level of a general administrative order and a ministerial regulation.
Omdat wordt voorzien in delegatiegrondslagen moet nog uitwerking op het niveau van een algemene maatregel van bestuur en van een ministeriële regeling plaatsvinden.
d: rules on suspension and withdrawal of traffic controller appointments
categories of mobile objects for register and rules on its contents and data use
requirements for vehicle maintenance under treaties and EU decisions
rules implementing a provision on driving-related matters
amount of examination costs and cases where the person bears them
exemption from road-use rules for licensed cash-transport firms
designation of EU directive to be observed and timing of amendments
p: The minister may exempt licensed cash-transport firms from municipal access restrictions on roads, reducing municipal regulatory power.
A register of mobile objects with data processing rules set by ministerial regulation, allowing future expansion to vessels and other objects.

parties: Asks why the government chose its approach, prefers self-regulation over new law, and asks the government not to go further in implementing air-conditioning rules than international obligations strictly require.
The CDA members ask the government not to go further in its elaboration than is strictly necessary under the aforementioned international legal obligations.

De leden van de CDA-fractie verzoeken de regering om niet verder te gaan in haar uitwerking dan strikt noodzakelijk wordt geacht in het kader van eerder genoemde internationaalrechtelijke verplichtingen.
Asks for clear, uniform rules on who pays for examinations and for the administrative burden on citizens to be explained, to prevent confusion and arbitrariness.
The members can accept the proposed change but ask the government to clarify when costs are or are not passed on, to prevent confusion and arbitrariness.

De leden kunnen zich vinden in de voorgestelde wijziging, maar verzoeken de regering duidelijkheid te verschaffen over wanneer de kosten wel of niet worden doorberekend, om verwarring en willekeur te voorkomen.

Doubts whether a general permission to reach shops is feasible and asks how enforcement against cash-in-transit vehicles in crowded streets would work; also questions whether centralised rules should extend to other areas such as disabled parking.
However, these members ask whether a general permission to reach shops is feasible.
Wel vragen deze leden of een algemene toestemming om winkels te bereiken haalbaar is.
Asks about costs of registering missing objects and maintaining the Mobile Objects Register, and about whether separate registers remain necessary and how they compare with other countries.
The ChristenUnie members ask what costs are involved in registering missing objects and maintaining the MOB.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen welke kosten er gemoeid zijn met het registreren van vermiste objecten en het in stand houden van het MOB.

31430.s: The bill creates a temporary experimental framework allowing municipalities to establish business improvement zones (BGV-zones) where property users pay a levy, approved by a supermajority of businesses, to fund extra public-interest activities run by an association or foundation. The law lapses on 1 July 2015 and requires an evaluation and a government position on continuation.
31430.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary, experimental framework and royal decree extensions by the lead time needed to set up zones and the need to avoid dissolving successful zones before a permanent law.
q: The experimental character of the law is shown primarily by its temporary effect through the sunset provision, under which the law in principle lapses on 1 January 2015.
Het experimentele karakter van de wet blijkt primair uit de tijdelijke werking als gevolg van de horizonbepaling die bepaalt dat de wet in beginsel per 1 januari 2015 vervalt.
d: setting levy rates differentiated by category or uniform amount
municipal ordinance rules on subsidy conditions and manner
royal decree extending deadline for establishing zones by up to 24 months
royal decree setting later end date for continued levies
royal decree setting entry into force date
p: Royal decrees may extend the zone-establishment deadline and the period for continued levies beyond the statutory dates set by parliament.
The minister must report to parliament on effectiveness and give a position on continuation, providing a review point.

parties: Wants a clear split between municipal tasks and the BGV body, a firm service-level agreement, and asks why the Council of State's state-aid concern is not addressed by notifying the European Commission.
Can the government explain why it was not chosen to make mandatory the agreements between businesses in the BGV zone and the municipality on service levels in the implementation agreement?

Kan de regering aangeven waarom er niet voor is gekozen de afspraken over tussen de ondernemers aangesloten bij de BGV-zone en de gemeente over het serviceniveau verplicht vast te leggen in de uitvoeringsovereenkomst?
Asks how overlap with municipal services is prevented, who decides disputes, whether property owners should be taxpayers, and who sets differentiation criteria and the consent procedure.
If there is a dispute over (financial) responsibility: which body gives the final judgment?
Als er een geschil is over de (financiële) verantwoordelijkheid: wie of welke instantie geeft het eindoordeel?
Supports collective investment but objects to unequal voting weight by property value rather than one-man-one-vote, and asks for owner liability for neglected maintenance.
Is there not inequality of treatment between small and large entrepreneurs here? Would a one-man-one-vote system not be fairer?
Is hier niet sprake van rechtsongelijkheid tussen kleine ondernemers en grote ondernemers? Zou een systeem van «one man one vote» niet eerlijker zijn?
Objects to hidden levies such as the Leiden model, asks for a proper definition of public interest and for transparent separate assessment, and questions the 2/3 consent threshold.
What does the government think of this 'sneaky' levy?
Wat vindt de regering van deze «stiekeme» heffing?
Asks whether mandatory charges create unfair competition with non-zone shops and whether municipalities will shift financial responsibilities onto business.
These members ask how it is prevented that municipalities will in future shift all financial responsibilities that now lie with the municipalities onto business.
Deze leden vragen hoe wordt voorkomen dat gemeenten alle financiële verantwoordelijkheden die nu bij de gemeenten zelf liggen, in de toekomst bij het bedrijfsleven worden neergelegd.

v.summary: The Council of State advised against proceeding with the Experimentenwet BGV-zones in its current form, citing complex procedures, the transfer of tax-setting discretion to business associations, unlawful delegation and a binding vote of potential taxpayers. The government's reply (nader rapport) substantially revised the bill, replacing the application and voting procedure with regular council tax ordinances conditional on sufficient support, and largely adopted the Council's remarks.
concerns: Granting business associations an initiative right over local taxation undermines the municipal council's exclusive tax-setting power, so the procedure was dropped and council ordinances restored.
Delegating tax rate and base setting to the college of mayor and aldermen conflicts with the Gemeentewet prohibition on delegation; the delegation provision was removed.
Binding the college's decision to a vote among potential taxpayers is an impermissible encroachment on the municipal council's constitutional tax competence under Article 132 Grondwet.
The complex procedure is likely to hinder rather than stimulate local collective initiatives; the government simplified the procedure but retained a limited draagvlak mechanism.
The levy should perhaps also apply to property owners, given that vacancy harms area quality; the government declined in general, keeping only users as taxpayers.
Possible state aid concerns under the Pearle criteria were raised; the government revised the bill so state aid is largely excluded and dropped the call for Commission approval.
The selection of experiment municipalities by chambers of commerce and the quorum for the vote were criticized and subsequently removed or raised.
Redactional remarks on the bill text were noted and addressed, and co-signature by the Minister of Interior was added.

31520.s: The bill amends the WAO and WAZ disability insurance acts so that work income earned by benefit recipients is not counted as work for five years from the first day of earnings, and the benefit is not withdrawn or revised during that period. After five years the work is treated as ordinary work under the relevant article, and the cap for the remaining period is extended from three to five years.

parties: Asks for a clearer definition of when UWV may re-assess a benefit recipient, to avoid residual uncertainty, and whether the SER advice on the five-year period was considered.
It is unclear what is meant by a change in the medical situation and whether the UWV can initiate a re-assessment on its own initiative.
Niet duidelijk is wat onder een wijziging in de medische situatie moet worden verstaan en of de UWV uit eigener beweging tot een herbeoordeling kan overgaan.
Welcomes the bill but asks whether contacting UWV for income information could trigger re-assessment, and proposes alternative channels for information.
Can the government guarantee that a request for information on the financial effects of resuming work is not recorded in the file of the WAO and WAZ recipients concerned.
Kan de regering toezeggen dat een verzoek om informatie over de financiële effecten van eventuele werkhervatting niet wordt genoteerd in het dossier van de betrokken WAO’ers en WAZ’ers.
Positive about the proposed change and has no written questions.
The SP members are positive about the proposed amendment to the WAO and WAZ and have no further written questions.
De leden van de SP-fractie staan positief tegenover de voorgestelde wijziging van de WAO en WAZ en hebben verder geen schriftelijke vragen.
Questions whether the five-year period is arbitrary and whether mandatory periodic re-assessment every three years was considered, and asks for budget effects in financial terms.
Nevertheless the VVD members ask whether the proposed changes are the best possible improvements.
Toch vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie of de voorgestelde wijzigingen de best mogelijke verbeteringen zijn.
Argues the five-year re-assessment period is too long and should be shortened to test work capacity sooner, and asks about foreign-resident beneficiaries and how they are checked.
Should this period not rather be shortened to assess people's work capacity sooner and thereby encourage them to return to work?
Zou deze termijn juist niet moeten worden verkort om mensen sneller op hun arbeidsgeschiktheid te kunnen beoordelen en daarmee te prikkelen om weer aan het werk te gaan?
Welcomes protection against benefit reduction after relapse but asks about how cumulative working years are counted and whether article 44 is widely known.
They attach importance to people moving from a disability benefit to work not having to immediately fear a reduction of the benefit in case of relapse.
Zij hechten er belang aan dat mensen, die vanuit een arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering aan het werk gaan, niet meteen hoeven te vrezen voor verlaging van de uitkering, wanneer sprake is van terugval.
Asks why the government focuses only on financial uncertainty and not on health risks, and how UWV will inform beneficiaries proactively.
The SGP members ask why the government does not address the other research findings from the study on uncertainties in resuming work.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen waarom de regering niet ingaat op de andere onderzoeksresultaten uit het onderzoek «Onzekerheden bij werkhervatting».

31700-IIA.s: This bill sets the 2009 budget of the States General (IIA) at expenditure of about EUR 133.6 million and receipts of about EUR 2.5 million, split into separate budgets for the States General and for the Council of State, Audit Office, National Ombudsman and related cabinets. The explanatory memorandum describes spending for both chambers, parliamentary scrutiny, interparliamentary relations and unforeseen costs, with no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The Eerste Kamer forms the States General together with the Tweede Kamer.
De Eerste Kamer vormt samen met de Tweede Kamer de Staten-Generaal.

31965-F.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds), raising its expenditure and commitments under article 1 (animal disease control and welfare) by EUR 18.773 thousand following the spring budget memorandum. It takes effect on 1 June 2009 with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The 2009 budget statement of the Animal Health Fund is amended as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Diergezondheidsfonds voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32015.s: The bill amends Book 1 of the Civil Code, the Code of Civil Procedure, the Youth Care Act and the Foster Children Act to reform child protection measures, placing the child's development and the child's interest first. It narrows and restructures the guardianship and supervision (ondertoezichtstelling) measures, introduces a single gezagsbeëindiging ground, and adds a mayor's route to court and information-sharing rules for supervised children.
32015.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the need for stability and continuity for children, the critiques of current law, and the need for a clearer separation between the executive agency and the decision-making court.
q: The bill does not change the purpose of executing supervision, namely supervising the minor and giving help and support to the parents.
Het wetsvoorstel wijzigt niets aan het doel van de uitvoering van de ondertoezichtstelling, namelijk het houden van toezicht op de minderjarige en het geven van hulp en steun aan de ouders.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel H (art. 255, vijfde lid BW)
court sets concrete threats and duration of supervision
p: Artikel I, onderdeel E / Artikel III onderdeel B (art. 53 Wet op de jeugdzorg)
Parents lose part of their consent rights over data processing by the Bureau Jeugdzorg during supervision, and the agency may obtain information from third parties without consent.
The court may transfer part of parental authority (education, medical consent, residence permits) to the supervising foundation during out-of-home placement.
Foster parents' consent to changes in placement can be replaced by a judge's consent only where the judge deems it necessary in the child's interest.

parties: Worries that parents' interests are compromised, that truth-finding in court is lacking, and objects to removing the dispute settlement scheme and tightening of review duties.
Welcomes some improvements but asks critical questions about caseloads, waiting lists, the effectiveness of supervision and whether lowering the threshold for supervision orders is proportionate.
Supports lowering the threshold for supervision orders in principle but asks whether municipalities can deliver the required non-voluntary help and how removals in lighter cases are justified.
Broadening supervision orders can only work in practice if municipalities actually make the necessary help available.
De verruiming van de ondertoezichtstelling kan in de praktijk alleen slagen als de gemeenten daadwerkelijk de benodigde hulp beschikbaar kunnen stellen.
Supports early intervention but asks whether lowering the threshold and direct removal respect family life under Article 8 ECHR and whether adequate safeguards exist for parents.
How does it guarantee that the balance does not tip too far, given the protection that Article 8 ECHR affords the home situation.
Hoe waarborgt zij dat de balans niet te ver doorschiet, gelet op de bescherming die artikel 8 EVRM biedt aan de thuissituatie.
Warns that expanding state powers over child rearing may be disproportionate under Article 8 ECHR, lacking convincing evidence of serious threats, and fears bureaucratisation.
Measures expanding supervision orders, let alone guardianship through broader possibilities for ending parental authority, can quickly take on a disproportionate character in that light.

Maatregelen tot verruiming van de ondertoezichtstelling, laat staan tot verruiming van de voogdij door ruimere mogelijkheden tot gezagsbeëindiging, kunnen in dat licht al snel een disproportioneel karakter krijgen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against proceeding with the bill to broaden child protection supervision orders (ots) and the grounds for ending parental authority, arguing the measure's effectiveness is unproven and implementation is inadequate. The government's reply (nader rapport) rejected the central objection that the bill should be limited to technical changes, defending the broadening with planned improvements, and adopted several of the Raad's specific drafting and rights-protection suggestions.
concerns: The Raad doubts the effectiveness of the current ots and advises against broadening it until effectiveness and implementation improve; the government responds that improvements are underway and will be checked before entry into force.

The Raad finds that broadening the ots to relatively light problems and the risk of a funnel effect leading to ending parental authority is disproportionate under Article 8 ECHR; the government adds clarifications to the explanatory memorandum but keeps the broadened grounds.

The Raad objects that the 'onbedreigd opgroeien' norm overburdens parents and that the grounds should be tied to concrete threats; the government removed that phrase and reformulated the grounds around concrete threats to development.
The Raad advises creating a separate light measure for relatively light problems; the government declined, arguing existing voluntary help and the ots suffice.

The Raad asks that the duty to restore family ties be retained and that the grounds for authority restoration be nuanced; the government reinstated the family-ties provision and amended the relevant articles.
The Raad advises reinstating the dispute-resolution mechanism for ots implementation; the government declined, citing risk to separation of executive and judiciary.
The Raad considers the binding-warning enforcement with dwangmiddelen premature; the government retained it but made it subject to judicial assessment.
The Raad gave numerous redactional comments on wording and cross-references, most of which were adopted in the revised text.

32042.s: The bill seeks parliamentary approval, under Article 91(1) of the Constitution, of a 2009 Paris agreement amending the 1979 Franco-Dutch treaty on reprocessing spent nuclear fuel in France. Once approved, the amending agreement enters into force for the Netherlands the day after the State Gazette publication.

parties: Asks about urgency, stockpile volumes and whether the treaty's time limits extend beyond the EPZ convenant.
These members realise that, because of new French legislation, it is necessary to supplement the basic agreements made in 1979.
Deze leden realiseren zich dat het vanwege nieuwe Franse wetgeving noodzakelijk is de basisafspraken aan te vullen.
Asks whether the Netherlands is obliged to reprocess waste and why EPZ's responsibility for plutonium and RepU is not explicit.
The PvdA members ask the government to explain why article 8 does not explicitly state that EPZ remains responsible for storage of plutonium and RepU.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie verzoeken de regering om een toelichting waarom aan artikel 8 niet (expliciet) is toegevoegd dat EPZ verantwoordelijk blijft voor de opslag.
Worries the state gives up sovereignty for a deal between private parties and asks whether the Netherlands can refuse export licences.
Furthermore, the SP members ask whether the Dutch government, by signing the agreement, gives up its sovereignty for an arrangement between two private parties.
Voorts vragen de genoemde leden of de Nederlandse regering met ondertekening van de overeenkomst haar soevereiniteit opgeeft ten behoeve van een afspraak tussen twee private partijen.
Asks how much material is sent to France and what extra costs arise for which parties.
The VVD members wonder how much material the Netherlands sends to France for reprocessing.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen zich af hoeveel materiaal er door Nederland naar Frankrijk wordt gestuurd voor opwerking.
Questions reprocessing given OSPAR goals, asks about storage capacity, plutonium ownership and responsibility for contaminated legacy sites.
Can the government explain why it nonetheless intends to cooperate in resuming reprocessing of nuclear waste from the Borssele plant?
Kan de regering uitleggen waarom zij desondanks toch van plan is mee te werken aan het hervatten van het opwerken van kernafval uit de kerncentrale Borssele?
Asks whether the state unnecessarily gives up policy room on future reprocessing choices and whether an export licence can be refused.
The ChristenUnie members ask the government whether the Dutch state, with this treaty, unnecessarily gives away policy room regarding future reprocessing choices.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen de regering of de Nederlandse staat met dit Verdrag niet onnodig beleidsruimte ten aanzien van toekomstige keuzes over opwerking uit handen geeft.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the explanatory memorandum should address how the 2009 Paris amendment to the 1979 reprocessing treaty with France relates to Euratom Directive 2006/117 and EU law, particularly the arbitration clause in article 9 that could bypass the Court of Justice's exclusive jurisdiction under Article 193 Euratom. The government's reply (nader rapport) states that the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented as advised, including on paragraph 1 and the commentary on article 9, and adopts the editorial remark.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should discuss the relationship between the treaty and Directive 2006/117 and the consequences for the arbitration clause in article 9, given the Court of Justice's exclusive jurisdiction under Article 193 Euratom.
An editorial remark asks that the memorandum state that after Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba join the Netherlands the treaty will apply only to the European part of the Netherlands.

32123-IIA.s: This bill fixes the 2010 budget of the Dutch States General (Eerste and Tweede Kamer) in thousands of euros, effective 1 January 2010. The explanatory memorandum sets out budget articles for each chamber and the interparliamentary budget, with no delegation of rule-making or executive power.
q: The budget statement of the States General (IIA) for the year 2010 attached to this act is hereby adopted.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2010 wordt vastgesteld.

32132.s: The bill abolishes the Dutch aviation tax by deleting the aviation tax provisions (chapter VII) and the definition in article 1 of the Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag, and removes the corresponding cross-reference in article 91. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: Chapter VII lapses.
Hoofdstuk VII vervalt.

parties: Welcomes the abolition of the aviation tax without raising checks on the executive.
The CDA members have noted with approval the abolition of the aviation tax.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van de afschaffing van de vliegbelasting.
Supports the bill but asks the government about the Raad van State advice and the promised cabinet opinion on the Cramer motion before debate.
The VVD members ask what the status is of the commitment to send an updated cost-reduction and investment analysis for Schiphol with a cabinet opinion before the bill is debated.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe het staat met de toezegging ter uitvoering van de motie Cramer om een actualisatie van de kostenreductie en de investeringen van Schiphol, voorzien van een kabinetsoordeel, vóór de behandeling van onderhavig wetsvoorstel aan de Staten-Generaal te zenden.
Asks for a full list of fiscal measures internalising social costs and for data on airport losses and implementation costs, requesting transparency from the government.
The PVV members ask the government to provide a list of all fiscal measures that build social costs into prices.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen de regering een lijst te verstrekken met alle fiscale maatregelen waarbij de maatschappelijke kosten in uitdrukking zijn gebracht in de prijs.
Criticises the bill as stepping back from taxing the aviation sector and questions the effect of the ETS on growth.
The GroenLinks members have noted with disapproval the bill amending the Environmental Taxes Act regarding the abolition of the aviation tax.

De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks hebben met afkeuring kennisgenomen van het voorstel ter wijziging van de Wet Belastingen op milieugrondslag, in verband met de afschaffing van de vliegbelasting.
Regrets that no better alternative was sought and asks whether temporary retention at zero rate or EU emissions trading could achieve the same CO2 reduction.
The SP members regret that no better alternative to the aviation tax was sought.
De leden van de fractie van de SP betreuren het dat er niet is gezocht naar een beter alternatief voor de vliegbelasting.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the bill abolishing the aviation tax be given a sound reasoned justification, since the policy goal of reflecting social costs in prices was abandoned without explanation, and suggested the tax could be kept at zero as a temporary measure pending the EU ETS from 2012. The government's reply states that the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented with the reasons for abolition, namely the wish to give the sector certainty and avoid keeping a zero-rate law on the books, and that the editorial remark was followed.
concerns: The Council asked that the abandonment of the policy goal of reflecting social costs in prices be justified, which the government addressed by supplementing the explanatory memorandum.
The Council noted that keeping the tax at zero as a temporary stimulus measure could be an alternative, which the government did not adopt, arguing legal clarity and certainty for the sector.
The Council made an editorial remark about the bill's form, which the government adopted.

32141.s: The bill amends the Dutch Pensioenwet so that company pension funds can merge and cover several companies or groups, each with its own representation in the board and participant council. It also requires separate asset pools per company or group and applies the financial test per separate pool.
32141.j: The memorandum justifies the new possibility of merging company pension funds as a way to counter the decline in their number, and notes that the supervisor (DNB) may need extra effort initially.

parties: Questions the choice of the narrow variant, the five-year requirement, dilution of works council and board representation, and the practical workability of ringfencing and exit.
In addition, in such a case there would be a strong dilution of the control of the companies and participants involved in the multi-opf.
Daar komt bij dat in een dergelijk geval voor de betrokken ondernemingen en deelnemers sterke verwatering van hun zeggenschap in het multi-opf het gevolg zal zijn.
Supports the possibility of merging small funds to improve governance, while asking the government to confirm that ringfencing works as intended.
They support the possibility for (small) company pension funds to merge in order to optimise governance capacity.
Zij zijn voorstander van de mogelijkheid van het samengaan van (kleine) ondernemingspensioenfondsen teneinde de bestuurskracht te optimaliseren.
Asks how retirees will be represented on the multi-opf board and whether creditor claims are limited to the ringfenced assets, requesting a guaranteed seat for retirees.

Therefore the SP members propose to include in the law that, alongside an employer representative, there is a representative of the employees and a representative of the retirees on the multi-opf board.

Daarom stellen de leden van de SP-fractie voor om in de wet op te nemen, dat naast een vertegenwoordiger van de werkgevers er een vertegenwoordiger van de werknemers en een vertegenwoordiger van de gepensioneerden in het multi-opf bestuur wordt opgenomen.

Generally positive about merging, but questions the relationship to the API phasing, the need for a Pensioenwet article 100 consultation, board and works council structure, and European law consequences.
In the view of the VVD members, the Council of State makes some valid remarks about the lack of clarity regarding the relationships within the board of a multi-opf.
De Raad van State maakt naar de mening van de leden van de VVD-fractie enkele terechte opmerkingen over de onduidelijkheid met betrekking tot de verhoudingen binnen het bestuur van een multi-opf.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill creating a multi-company pension fund (Multi-opf) should be reconsidered, citing unclear governance, risks to participants, and missing justification for deviating from pension law principles. The government's reply accepted several points, notably mandatory ringfencing and clarifying the Multi-opf's position, while rejecting the call for a uniform entry/exit procedure and an explicit evaluation clause.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for clearer justification of the Multi-opf's position relative to company and sector pension funds and for explanation of deviations from pension law principles; the government revised the explanatory memorandum to make the deviations explicit.

The Afdeling asked why the existing legal options for cooperation and integration are insufficient and whether they could be expanded instead of creating a new vehicle; the government argued cooperation cannot share board responsibility and retained the Multi-opf.

Concerns about board size and diluted representation in a multi-company board, and about unclear participation rules for works councils; the government capped participants and required representation from each organisation in the participants' council.
The Afdeling argued that leaving ringfencing optional creates risks for participants; the government adopted ringfencing as the statutory starting point.
The Afdeling asked for a uniform procedure for joining and leaving a Multi-opf with sufficient safeguards; the government found statutory procedures unnecessary.
The Afdeling asked for a statutory evaluation clause with a fixed review period; the government preferred an evaluation after about five years without a fixed statutory deadline.

32150.s: The bill requires the Sociale Verzekeringsbank to determine insurance status for AWBZ coverage and allows the CVZ to trace uninsured persons, fine them, and ultimately insure them ex officio, while limiting each person to one health insurance policy. It introduces a bestuursrechtelijke premie for ex officio insured persons over 18, excludes administrative appeal against that premium, and adds a three-year evaluation duty.
32150.j: The memorandum justifies the new CVZ powers by the need to ensure that persons with a statutory insurance obligation are actually insured, and frames the fining system on traffic-fine logic.
q: The chosen system resembles the system used for traffic fines.
Het gekozen systeem lijkt op het systeem dat wordt gehanteerd bij verkeersboetes.
d: designation of databases for matching uninsured persons
cases in which CVZ issues certificate of non-insurance (second sentence removed)
p: The CVZ may trace, fine and ex officio insure uninsured persons, with only limited administrative appeal options through the stepwise procedure.
Ex officio insured persons over 18 owe a mandatory administrative premium, and under Art. 4 of the amendment appeal against it is excluded.

Administrative appeal against the premium decision is excluded and the Centrale Raad van Beroep appeal route for fines is removed, though judicial review by the district court remains for other decisions.
The Sociale Verzekeringsbank becomes exclusively competent to determine AWBZ insurance status of individuals.

parties: Questions the complexity of the three-stage procedure, the effectiveness of the second fine, the legal remedies available to those written to, and the ex officio placement without choice of insurer.
Do the CDA members understand correctly that the person concerned has no freedom of choice of health insurer?
Begrijpen de leden van de CDA-fractie het goed dat betrokkene hierbij geen keuzevrijheid heeft voor een zorgverzekeraar?
Asks about the evaluation of the information campaign, the basis for expected effects of fines, and the capacity of the CVZ to carry out the expanded tasks, noting Raad van State doubts.

The explanatory memorandum states that 'the fine regime has not proven an adequate instrument in all respects', while the Council of State, citing the Ombudsman report, also has reservations about a renewed fine regime.

In de Memorie van Toelichting wordt gesteld dat «het boeteregiem niet in alle opzichten een adequaat middel is gebleken», terwijl de Raad van State vanwege de rapportage van Stichting De Ombudsman ook bedenkingen bij een vernieuwd boeteregiem heeft.
Asks that the reasons for being uninsured and ability to pay fines be examined before enforcement, and asks whether a one-time amnesty should be considered; prefers tax-based premium collection.
The SP members therefore request the government, when uninsured persons are traced under this bill, to examine why people became uninsured and whether they are able to pay the fine.

De leden van de SP-fractie verzoeken de regering dan ook, wanneer op grond van dit wetsvoorstel onverzekerden worden opgespoord, dat dan wordt getoetst om welke reden mensen onverzekerd zijn geraakt en of zij in staat zijn de boete te voldoen.
Questions the justification for the complex procedure, the lower cost of being uninsured than being a non-payer, the administrative burden, and the feasibility of data linkage and the AWBZ database.
Is it not the case that people who withdraw from the solidarity principle should be punished rather than 'helped', instead of being helped?
Is het niet juist zo dat de mensen die zich aan de solidariteitsgedachte onttrekken in plaats van «geholpen worden» eerder gestraft zouden moeten worden?

v.summary: The Council of State supports the bill to trace and insure uninsured persons and prevent double insurance, but objects to the stacking of sanctions (two fines and a last before an ex officio insurance) and questions workability at the CVZ, advising a shorter procedure without fines. The government's reply rejects the proposed removal of the fine, arguing the fine is an effective preventive incentive, but adds a passage on the CVZ's phased implementation and the decision not to query municipal registries.
concerns: The Council doubts the effectiveness of successive punitive fines for people who are uninsured for financial reasons and advises dropping the fine stage, a point the government rejects as an effective preventive incentive.
The Council asks for a balance between simplification and a careful procedure, given that the required three decision moments may not be necessary and the stacking of decisions is complex.
The Council asks the explanatory memorandum to address the CVZ's capacity and the workability of the bill alongside the wanbetalers scheme, and the government adds a phased implementation passage.
Redactional remarks on inconsistent wording between articles 9c and 9d, exclusions from the Awb, and the lack of explanation on repeated fines are followed.

32222-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statement of the Dutch States General (the parliament's budget, IIA) in connection with the autumn budget memorandum, adjusting spending and receipts across its policy articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and specifies entry into force from 1 December 2009 (or retroactively if published after 1 June).
q: The budget statement concerning the States General for the year 2009 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat inzake de Staten-Generaal voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32240.s: The bill abolishes the municipalities of Bergen, Gennep and Mook en Middelaar and establishes a new municipality called Maasduinen on their combined territory. It makes consequential amendments to the judicial districts act, police act, safety regions act and sets an interim council election and transitional rules for the merger.
q: With effect from the date of reorganisation, the municipalities of Bergen, Gennep and Mook en Middelaar are abolished.
Met ingang van de datum van herindeling worden de gemeenten Bergen, Gennep en Mook en Middelaar opgeheven.
d: territory of new municipality per attached map

parties: Asks whether the drafting procedure and citizen objections were handled carefully and whether enough alternatives were examined.
Do you consider the preparatory procedure carried out by the province to have been careful?
Is de voorbereidingsprocedure door de provincie naar uw mening zorgvuldig verlopen?
Asks how the government views Bergen's negative decision and how citizen opinion was polled.
Can the government elaborate on how citizens' opinions in Bergen were polled and what the precise results were?
Kan de regering nader ingaan op de manier waarop de meningen van de burgers in Bergen gepeild zijn en wat de precieze uitkomsten hiervan waren?
Argues the merger was initiated by the province rather than from below and lacks sufficient popular and municipal support.
To begin with, this merger proposal was not started from the bottom up by the municipalities but on the initiative of the province of Limburg.
Om te beginnen is dit voorstel voor herindeling niet van onderaf door de gemeenten opgestart, maar op initiatief van de provincie Limburg.
Questions the proposal given weak administrative support and suggests the province reconsider with cross-border options.
Would it not be better for the province of Limburg to reconsider this merger and explicitly include solutions crossing provincial borders in its new deliberations?
Zou het niet beter zijn, dat de provincie Limburg zich opnieuw over deze herindeling buigt en bij haar nieuwe afwegingen nadrukkelijk provinciegrens overschrijdende oplossingen betrekt.
Argues that such far-reaching change requires majority support of residents and binding referenda, which were absent.
Thus the majority of residents of Bergen oppose the proposed merger.
Zo is de meerderheid van de inwoners van Bergen tegen de voorgestelde samenvoeging.
Asks whether alternatives to merger were pursued and how criteria were weighed, given the principle that mergers should be voluntary and bottom-up.
The starting point of these members is that municipal mergers should take place as far as possible on a voluntary basis and from the bottom up.
Het uitgangspunt van deze leden is dat herindeling zoveel mogelijk op vrijwillige basis en van onderaf dient plaats te vinden.
Requests information on neighbouring municipalities' objections and the financial basis for the new municipality.
To gain full insight into regional support, the CU members request further information on the objections submitted by surrounding and neighbouring municipalities to the provincial merger proposal.

Teneinde een volledig inzicht te krijgen in het regionaal draagvlak vragen de leden van de CU-fractie om nadere informatie omtrent de door omliggende en/of naburige gemeenten ingediende zienswijzen op het provinciale herindelingsontwerp.

32303.s: The bill amends the Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001 to stop annually indexing the lower threshold of the highest-rate bracket of the owner-occupied dwelling forfait (eigenwoningforfait), instead fixing it at the first-mentioned amount. It also makes conforming renumbering and cross-reference changes to articles 10.3, 10.4 and 10.5 and sets entry into force by royal decree.
32303.j: The memorandum justifies the change as part of a package to secure the long-term sustainability of public finances and collective provisions, without itself setting out a new executive power.
q: no longer indexing the lower limit of the bracket for the highest owner-occupied dwelling forfait, currently €1.01 million
het niet langer indexeren van de voor de schijf voor het hoogste eigenwoningforfait geldende ondergrens van € 1,01 miljoen
d: date of entry into force of the act

v.summary: The Council of State supports the bill to stop indexing the €1 million threshold for the owner-occupied home forfait as a sustainability measure, but asks for justification of this choice over other fiscal measures and for a substantiated estimate of the 0.2% GDP yield, its timing, and distributional effects. The government's reply rejects the call to justify the choice against other measures, but accepts the requests on yield, timing and distributional effects by supplementing the explanatory memorandum, except for adding distributional effects of the other sustainability measures.
concerns: The Council asks for justification of why this measure was chosen over other fiscal sustainability measures; the government considers the choice sufficiently explained in the coalition agreement and does not add a motivation.
The explanatory memorandum must substantiate that the 0.2% GDP budgetary target is reasonably assured with detailed figures; the memorandum was supplemented.
The memorandum should explain the speed at which the budgetary yield is reached, and this was added.

The Council asks for distributional effects, including purchasing power effects, of the measure and of the other sustainability measures; purchasing power effects were added but distributional effects of other measures were not, as they belong in their own bills.
The Council suggests adding a recital on sustainability of public finances and solid collective provisions for future generations; this was adopted.

32402.s: The bill strengthens the position of clients in healthcare by combining client rights and provider duties into one new statute, covering quality of care, information and consent, records, privacy, complaints and disputes, and participation. It also sets governance, financial and supervisory rules for care providers, including a College sanering and enforcement by the health inspectorate.
32402.j: The memorandum justifies delegation to general administrative orders by the need for flexible, quickly adjustable norms where the sector does not sufficiently define good care and for equipment rules that cannot be fixed in the statute itself.
q: This bill makes it possible to fill in norms for good care in a flexible and therefore agile way.
Dit wetsvoorstel maakt het mogelijk om normen voor goede zorg op een flexibele en daardoor slagvaardige wijze in te vullen.
d: rules on periodic quality and safety checks of equipment and on specifying the standard of good care
rules for the complaints institution to ensure expertise in military healthcare
which data must be provided in processed form and what must be included in annual accounts
categories of providers exempt from the profit distribution ban and rules on profit distributions
rules on financial consequences of sanering, subsidies and supervision, with College sanering rules
content of work programme, annual report, audit and budget procedure of the College sanering
p: Allows by general administrative order exempting parts of the Act for certain care categories such as dental interpreting, pharmaceutical care and transport.
Provider liability for subcontracted practitioners is made mandatory and cannot be limited, strengthening client protection.
Allows general administrative orders to set equipment inspection rules and to specify the norm of good care, with the standard set outside the statute itself.
Gives inspectors powers to enter homes without the occupant's consent and to inspect client files despite professional confidentiality, with inspectorate discretion on whether to act.
The minister approves the College sanering's rules and sets its budget, while the College itself decides on financial consequences and subsidies.

parties: Asks why separate laws remain, whether rewording well-functioning rules is justified, and how the broad expansion of IGZ powers will be carried out.
Why was it chosen to lay down a number of rights in separate laws, instead of in one integral law containing all rights and duties?
Waarom is ervoor gekozen een aantal rechten in separate wetten vast te leggen, in plaats van in één integrale wet waarin alle rechten en plichten zijn opgenomen?
Asks for a full overview of the many delegation provisions (AMvBs, ministerial regulations) and how the Chamber will be involved in their elaboration.
Can the government give a complete overview of all general administrative orders (AMvBs), ministerial regulations and minor royal decrees contained in the law?
Kan de regering een volledig overzicht geven van alle algemene maatregelen van bestuur (amvb's), ministeriële regelingen en kleine koninklijke besluiten die opgenomen zijn in de wet?
Welcomes the stronger client rights and checks and balances, but asks about the consequences of withdrawing the WTZi and who has the power to enforce continuity of care.
Who then has the power to enforce that, for example, a hospital or ward stays open?
Wie heeft dan de doorzettingsmacht om te zorgen dat er bijvoorbeeld een ziekenhuis of afdeling open blijft?
Objects to the law's private-law framing of care as a contract between equals and to liberalising provider entry; argues the state must retain the power to intervene in care processes.
Does the government acknowledge that by amending the many laws in this law, it becomes less or hardly possible for the government to intervene in undesirable care processes?
Erkent de regering dat met het wijzigen van de vele wetten in deze wet, het minder tot nauwelijks meer mogelijk is om als overheid in te grijpen in onwenselijke zorgprocessen?
Questions whether a new law is needed rather than better use of existing laws and communication, and whether the law strengthens or discourages patient engagement and raises enforceability concerns.

This indeed identifies the problem of accessibility and clarity of existing legislation, but passes over the RVZ's argument that existing legislation should be better anchored in professional practice than has been usual so far.

Hiermee wordt het probleem van de toegankelijkheid en inzichtelijkheid van bestaande wetgeving weliswaar aangeduid, maar wordt voorbijgegaan aan het argument van de RVZ om bestaande wetgeving beter dan tot nog toe gebruikelijk is te verankeren in de beroepspraktijk.
Asks whether the law will increase juridification, notes trust cannot be enforced by rights alone, and questions the relation to the planned Zorgbeginselenwet.
Will this bill not encourage further juridification?
Zal dit wetsvoorstel geen verdere juridisering in de hand werken?
Questions the need for the law and the breadth of OM access to internal incident-reporting data, which may deter reporting; asks for narrowing to cases of intent or gross negligence.
Will the government consider amending the proposal so that the OM only gets access to reports where intent or gross negligence is involved?
Wil de regering overwegen het voorstel zo aan te passen dat het OM alleen inzage krijgt in meldingen als sprake is van opzet of grove nalatigheid?
Asks how independence of complaints officers is guaranteed, whether complaints bodies can act on structural problems, and about the scope of reporting duties.
Questions whether the bill truly improves patient rights, asks why the Council of State was not re-consulted on the amendments, and wants a binding two-year evaluation clause.
Why does it not choose to withdraw the original proposal and come with a new law?
Waarom kiest zij er niet voor om het oorspronkelijke voorstel in te trekken en te komen met een nieuwe wet?
Wants clients able to report directly to the IGZ, a mandatory reporting duty for professionals, and questions the placement of the CSZ with the NZa.
Would it not be better for clients if the plan to place the CSZ with the NZa were abandoned?
Is het voor de cliënt niet beter wanneer er afgezien wordt van het voornemen om het CSZ onder te brengen bij de NZa
Asks whether the NZa can combine its regulatory, market-supervision and rescue roles, and about the scope of the professional confidentiality exception.
Can these roles be performed alongside each other?
Kunnen deze rollen naast elkaar vervuld worden?
Argues the bill overlaps the WGBO and does not improve clients' rights, citing criticism that the bill is diffuse and may hinder legal protection.
If matters can be improved on participation, co-decision and complaints rights, they propose improving the existing laws and withdrawing the Wcz.
Als er zaken verbeterd kunnen worden met inspraak, medezeggenschap en klachtrecht, stellen genoemde leden voor om de bestaande wetten die dit regelen te verbeteren en om de Wcz in te trekken.

Notes many objections remain, questions whether the amendments should go back to the Council of State, and worries about growing juridification and lack of client-friendly representation for vulnerable clients.
Given the large number of amendments, the ChristenUnie members think it sensible to submit the amended proposal again to the Council of State.
Vanwege het grote aantal wijzigingen, lijkt het de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie een verstandig besluit om dit gewijzigde voorstel opnieuw voor te leggen aan de Raad van State.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the draft Client Rights in Care Act (wet cliëntenrechten zorg) is not adequately justified in its necessity, is legally unclear, and should be reconsidered, criticising the individual rights framing, the unclear quality standard, the complicated complaints and co-determination arrangements, and the overlap with existing laws. The government's reply largely defends the bill's structure, accepts some changes such as separating complaint procedures less, adjusting co-determination rights and clarifying the zorgaanbieder obligations, but rejects the central objections on necessity and the scope of rights.
concerns: The Council found the necessity of the bill insufficiently justified, since the problems identified call for information and organisational measures rather than new legislation; the government maintains legislation is necessary.
The Council found the content and scope of the 'goede zorg' right unclear and the bill's standards unfit for an enforceable individual right; the government clarified the norm but kept it as a right.

The Council advised separating complaint handling on conduct from disputes on statutory compliance, and extending the six-week decision period; the government kept a combined procedure but added an extension option and clarified when the period starts.

The Council objected to broad co-determination rights and instemmingsrechten for client councils, and to the disconnect from the Wet op de ondernemingsraden; the government narrowed the rights and kept them in modified form.
The Council noted the bill's terminology and the cumbersome multiplicity of remaining statutes; the government revised the terminology explanations and committed to future integration.

32420.s: The bill implements EU Return Directive 2008/115/EC into the Dutch Aliens Act 2000 by defining return decisions and entry bans, creating a separate entry-ban section, and extending detention review and voluntary departure rules. Most detailed rules are left to ministerial regulations and general administrative orders.
32420.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed for technical detail, administrative speed and flexibility for situations not yet foreseen, while stating the Directive requires the changes.
q: The new fifth paragraph of Article 62 aims to implement the main element of Article 7(2) of the Directive.
Het nieuwe vijfde lid van artikel 62 strekt ertoe om het hoofdelement van artikel 7, tweede lid, van de richtlijn om te zetten.
d: rules on application of the entry-ban section
duration and cases of extending voluntary departure period
p: Detention may be extended by up to twelve further months where removal is delayed by the foreigner's non-cooperation or missing documents, with judicial review required beyond six months.
Minister may issue an entry ban of up to five years, longer for serious threats, with the ban applied through SIS signalling and removing lawful residence.
Extends the reach of public order and national security grounds to other Schengen states' territory under EU instruments.

parties: Wants to avoid procedural stacking of separately appealable decisions and asks whether detainees can be lawfully held and how procedural errors leading to release will be prevented.

These members consider it important that the concurrence of the various rejection decisions introduced by implementing the directive does not lead to independently appealable decisions, which would enable stacking of procedures.

Deze leden vinden het belangrijk dat samenloop van de verschillende afwijzende beschikkingen die met de implementatie van de richtlijn worden geïntroduceerd niet leidt tot zelfstandig appellabele besluiten, waardoor procedurestapeling mogelijk wordt.
Questions whether the entry ban could block asylum access and violate non-refoulement, and argues detention should be a last resort with minors and vulnerable people protected.

Does the government share the concern that where the personal situation of the foreigner or the situation in the country of origin gives reason, this could cause the Netherlands to violate the non-refoulement prohibition?

Deelt de regering de zorgen dat wanneer de persoonlijke situatie van de vreemdeling of de situatie in het land van herkomst daar aanleiding toe geven, ervoor kan zorgen dat Nederland dan het refoulementverbod schendt?
Opposes European interference in national immigration law and argues return decisions and entry bans are not effective enough against illegal residence.
The PVV members emphatically point out that they consider any form of European interference in national alien legislation highly undesirable.
De leden van de PVV-fractie wijzen er nadrukkelijk op dat de zij elke vorm van Europese inmenging in de nationale vreemdelingenwetgeving bijzonder onwenselijk achten.

Asks whether an imposed entry ban should be mandatory with a hardship clause, whether confusion between entry bans and declarations of undesirability could cause misapplication, and whether individual assessment is guaranteed.
Argues detention should be a strict last resort with alternatives, that the first judicial review after 28 days is too late, and that rights protection should take priority over practical objections.
Legal protection should take priority over practical objections.
Rechtsbescherming dient voorrang te krijgen boven praktische bezwaren.

Has reservations about the directive's content, questions how entry bans relate to non-refoulement and why extensions beyond five years were chosen, and asks about individual assessment and detention of vulnerable persons.
The D66 members ask the government to explain how imposing an entry ban relates to the non-refoulement prohibition in such cases.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering aan te geven hoe het opleggen van een inreisverbod zich in voorkomende gevallen verhoudt tot het non-refoulement verbod.

Supports the bill's premise but asks about sanctions for violating entry bans, measures when maximum detention is reached without prospect of return, and humane detention for return-directive detainees.
These members ask what measures are possible when the maximum detention period has been reached and there is no prospect of the foreigner's return.
Deze leden vragen welke maatregelen mogelijk zijn wanneer de maximale duur van detentie is bereikt en er geen zicht is op terugkeer van de vreemdeling.
Asks how entry bans fit with Article 8 ECHR, the scope of humanitarian exceptions, and how courts apply the Return Directive to detention extensions.
They would therefore like to know in which cases an entry ban may nevertheless be imposed where a violation of Article 8 ECHR has been established.
Graag vernemen deze leden dan ook in welke gevallen een inreisverbod, waarbij een schending van artikel 8 EVRM is geconstateerd, dan toch mag worden opgelegd.
Objects that criminalising illegality via an amendment during implementation is principally indefensible and asks for a separate legislative procedure and Raad van State advice.
The PvdA members consider it principled indefensible to use the implementation of the Return Directive to introduce a partial criminalisation of illegality by amendment.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie achten het principieel niet verdedigbaar om de implementatie van de Terugkeerrichtlijn te gebruiken om een gedeeltelijke strafbaarstelling van illegaliteit in te voeren per nota van wijziging.
Asks how the criminalisation linked to the coalition agreement relates to the implementing bill, without raising a check concern directly.
These members would like to know from the government how the aforementioned criminalisation should be viewed in light of the present amendment.
Graag vernemen deze leden van de regering hoe de genoemde strafbaarstelling moet worden gezien in het licht van de onderhavige wetswijziging.
Says introducing a new offence through a nota van wijziging bypasses the fundamental debate and advisory process that such a change requires.
A far-reaching change such as criminalising illegal residence, introducing a new offence, requires a fundamental debate surrounded by all possibilities of advice.

Over een ingrijpende wijziging als strafbaarstelling van illegaal verblijf, het introduceren van een nieuw misdrijf, zal een fundamenteel debat gevoerd moeten worden dat is omgeven met alle mogelijkheden van advisering.
Questions the necessity of criminal sanctions given existing tools, rights protections and detention concerns, and asks for a Raad van State advice on the amendment.
These members, like the ACVZ, expected and would have found it appropriate if a proposal for criminalisation had been drafted and submitted separately.
Deze leden hadden, net als de ACVZ verwacht en het gepast gevonden indien een voorstel tot strafbaarstelling apart was opgesteld en voorgelegd
Asks why criminalisation is needed for implementation, questions proportionality and effectiveness, and requests the amended bill be resubmitted to the Raad van State.
The ChristenUnie members request the government to resubmit the amended proposal to the Council of State.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie verzoeken de regering het gewijzigde voorstel opnieuw aan de Raad van State voor te leggen

v.summary: The Council of State advised on a bill implementing the EU Return Directive 2008/115/EC in the Aliens Act 2000, raising concerns about splitting legal remedies for accelerated-procedure asylum cases, the unclear structure of the Schengen entry ban versus the national declaration of undesirability, sanctions, the start date of the entry ban, and detention of asylum seekers. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely followed the advice, restructuring the provisions and clarifying the text and explanatory memorandum.
concerns: Separate appealable return decisions in AC cases would create an unjustified split in legal remedies; the scope of article 62(6) was narrowed so AC cases are excluded.
The unclear relationship between the Schengen entry ban and the national declaration of undesirability was restructured into separate sections, as advised.
Articles 67, 67a and 68 needed alignment, and the scope of the entry ban for EU/EEA and Swiss nationals was to be stated explicitly.
The Council asked for explanation of effective, deterrent and proportionate sanctions for violating the Schengen entry ban; the reply added criminal sanctions in relevant cases.
Detention rules in article 59 wrongly covered asylum seekers under the Return Directive, following the Kadzoev judgment; the scope was narrowed accordingly.
The start date of the five-year entry ban was unclear and the explanatory memorandum was to be supplemented.
Missing legal basis for lifting a national declaration of undesirability was to be provided.
Redactional remarks in the annex were largely followed, including cross-reference corrections and transposition table additions.

32500-IIB.s: The bill formally establishes the 2011 budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden and the governors' cabinets of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten. The explanatory memorandum sets out their objectives, workloads and budgetary effects without delegating rule-making power.
q: This statutory article aims to establish the 2011 budget statement for the Council of State, the Court of Audit, the National Ombudsman, the Chancery of the Netherlands Orders, and the cabinets of the governors of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten.

Het onderhavige wetsartikel strekt ertoe om de begrotingsstaat van de Raad van State, de Algemene Rekenkamer, de Nationale ombudsman, de Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden, het Kabinet van de Gouverneur van Aruba, het Kabinet van de Gouverneur van Curaçao en het Kabinet van de Gouverneur van Sint Maarten (IIB) voor het jaar 2011 vast te stellen.

32565-I.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Royal Household (begroting van de Koning), adjusting expenditure lines in thousands of euros following the Najaarsnota. It sets the amendment's effective date as 1 December 2010 with retroactive effect where the gazette is published later.
q: The budget statement belonging to the budget of the King (I) for the year 2010 is amended, as shown in the statement annexed to this law.
De begrotingstaat behorende bij de begroting van de Koning (I) voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32565-XVIII.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statements for Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration (Wonen, Wijken en Integratie) and the budget for the state-owned services, mainly via the autumn supplementary budget. It also transfers management responsibility for the Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration budget to the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations from 14 October 2010.
32565-XVIII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by policy developments and technical budget mutations, but does not explicitly justify the reassignment of budget management in Article 4.
q: For the year 2010, in deviation from Article 19a, first paragraph, of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, from 14 October 2010 the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations is responsible for managing the budget of Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration.

Voor het jaar 2010 geldt dat in afwijking van artikel 19a, eerste lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 vanaf 14 oktober 2010 Onze Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties verantwoordelijk is voor het beheer van de begroting van Wonen, Wijken en Integratie.
p: Article 4 reassigns management responsibility for the Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration budget to the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations, departing from the default rule of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.

32600.s: The bill caps annual pay and severance for top officials in the public and semi-public sector, setting statutory maximum amounts and sectoral norms that can be lowered by ministerial regulation. It requires publication of individual executive pay by name, with the minister able to enforce compliance through compliance orders, penalty payments and recovery of undue payments.
32600.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the complexity of the sectors and the need to tailor norms to different subsectors and labour markets, and the need for enforcement tools to prevent circumvention.
q: The cabinet wants to prevent that including a list of grounds for deviation increases the risk of circumvention of the law.
Het kabinet wil voorkomen dat met het opnemen van een lijst van gronden voor afwijking het risico op ontduiking van de wet wordt vergroot.
d: details of what counts as pay and timing of components
adding or removing entities from the annex list
annual adjustment of the maximum pay amounts
higher pay maximum for functions at private-law bodies where labour market requires
lower pay maximum for specified sectors of entities
individual exceptions allowing pay above the maximum, decided jointly by ministers
changing the severance ceiling of 75,000 euro
rules on how publication costs are set and charged
p: Ministers may jointly approve pay above the statutory maximum for individual entities, with notice published in the Staatscourant only.
Ministers set lower or higher sector and class pay limits and assign entities to classes by ministerial regulation, outside parliamentary control.
The minister can impose compliance orders with penalty payments and recover undue payments directly, with reclaimed amounts going to the State.
Agreed pay above the cap is void by operation of law, with undue payments recoverable except where based on a court ruling.

parties: Supports a statutory pay norm in principle but asks for justification of which sectors fall under the bill, of the exemption and ministerial discretion mechanisms, and of the proposed permanent advisory college.
They support in principle a statutory norm for top incomes in the public and semi-public sector.
Zij steunen in principe een wettelijke normering van topinkomens in de publieke en semipublieke sector.
Considers the bill insufficiently far-reaching, questions the wide ministerial exemption power and the deviation from the Dijkstal advice, and asks for a universal maximum instead of sectoral norms.
In their view, tying top salaries to a clear maximum could be done far more effectively than the government currently proposes.
Naar hun mening kan de binding van topsalarissen aan een duidelijk maximum veel effectiever plaatsvinden dan de regering momenteel voorstelt.
Moderately positive towards the bill, reserving further views for plenary debate.
The PVV members are moderately positive about this bill.
De leden van de PVV-fractie staan gematigd positief tegenover dit wetsvoor-stel.

Endorses the goal of capping top incomes but asks for objective justification of the 130% ministerial-salary benchmark, the exemption procedure before the Council of Ministers, and coverage of interim managers.
Can the government substantively justify why the top of the public sector is defined in this bill as the euro amount equal to a ministerial salary plus 30%?

Kan de regering inhoudelijk motiveren, waarom de top in de publieke sector in het voorliggende wetsvoorstel wordt gedefinieerd als het bedrag in euro's dat overeenkomt met een ministersalaris plus 30%.

Disappointed that the norm does not cover all sectors and that the cap is 30% above ministerial pay; argues no one in the semi-public sector should earn more than a minister and questions the three-regime structure.
In their view no one in the semi-public sector should receive higher pay than the minister, who bears ultimate political responsibility.
Naar hun opvatting zou niemand in een semipublieke sector een hogere beloning moeten krijgen dan de minister, die immers de politieke eindverantwoordelijkheid draagt.

Shares the Council of State's concern that the exemption power is insufficiently bounded and asks for concrete criteria, inventory of deviations, and more democratic appointment of advisory college members.
They consider the government's answer to this concern insufficient.
Zij menen dat het antwoord van de regering op deze vrees onvoldoende is.
Asks whether a parliamentary pre-consultation procedure will apply to lower ministerial ceilings and about labour-market effects and indexation of the norm.
These members ask the government whether a pre-consultation procedure will be applied to this so-called lowered ceiling set by ministerial regulation.
Deze leden vragen de regering of voor dit zogenaamde «verlaagd plafond», dat door middel van een ministeriele regeling wordt vastgesteld, een voorhangprocedure zal worden toegepast.
Asks for a clearly defined problem statement before new legislation, why targeted improvement of existing rules or funding conditions was not chosen, and for clearer criteria for coverage.
Before new legislation is necessary, in the view of the SGP members the problem statement must first be unambiguously clear.
Voordat nieuwe wetgeving noodzakelijk is, moet naar de mening van de leden van de SGP-fractie eerst de probleemstelling ondubbelzinnig helder zijn.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory opinion of 27 August 2010 supports the bill capping pay of top officials in publicly and semi-publicly funded organisations, but raises objections on motivation, the generic versus sector-specific approach, the scope criteria, the ministerial discretion for exemptions, the inclusion of employer organisations in education, subsidiaries, and the minister's recovery power. The government's nader rapport of 5 January 2011 accepts or explains most points, amends the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly, and keeps the core structure.
concerns: The Council doubts the necessity of the bill given that the Wopt appears to work well and asks for convincing justification in the explanatory memorandum; the government supplements the memorandum with figures but maintains a separate objective.

The Council says that mandatory public disclosure intrudes on privacy and salary capping on contractual freedom, so the necessity must be convincingly shown; the reply does not substantively address this balance.

The Council asks for a reasoned choice of a generic rather than sector-specific approach and for clearer scope criteria (financing, legal task, public interest, competition); the government defends the generic approach and refines the criteria.
The Council finds the exemption power in article 2.3 insufficiently normed without substantive criteria; the government adds that exemptions are meant to be exceptional and adds explanatory text.

The Council questions the definition of related entities (gelieerde vennootschappen) regarding joint ventures and management companies; the government clarifies the definition and explanatory memorandum.

The Council questions the minister's recovery power and payment of recovered sums to the State rather than the organisation; the government justifies the choice on effectiveness grounds and does not restitute the funds to the organisation.

The Council asks that the bill and explanatory memorandum be harmonised and that the reference to the 2007 coalition agreement and the scope of officials be clarified; the government makes corresponding editorial changes.

33000-X.s: This bill fixes the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence, including its operational expenditure and revenue figures, and the budget statements of its three baten-lastendiensten (DTO, DVD and Paresto). The explanatory memorandum extract is largely a catalogue of budget detail, policy indicators and abbreviations rather than discussion of delegation or oversight.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2012 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2012 wordt vastgesteld.

33005.s: The bill exempts the tax authority's income-dependent benefit (tegemoetkoming) decisions from the administrative-law penalty-payment rule for late decisions, and lets the minister by ministerial regulation switch that rule off temporarily during serious implementation disruptions. Any such regulation must be submitted to the Tweede Kamer as an approval bill within eight weeks and is withdrawn if parliament rejects it.
33005.j: The memorandum justifies the power by the risk of very large penalty-payment liabilities and by the need for a legal basis to suspend the rule in calamity situations.
q: This measure serves to provide a legal basis in such exceptional situations for not applying the penalty-payment rule until the disruption has been remedied.
Deze maatregel dient ertoe om in dit soort uitzonderingssituaties een wettelijke basis te hebben om de dwangsomregeling niet toe te passen, tot dat de verstoring weer is verholpen.
d: temporarily disapplying penalty-payment rule during implementation disruptions
p: Citizens lose the penalty-payment protection for late benefit decisions, and the minister may suspend it by regulation during disruptions, subject to later parliamentary approval.

parties: Asks for further explanation of the three proposed measures, the criteria 'extreme situations' and 'large disruptions' for temporary suspension of the regime, and whether the budgetary risk can be mitigated for later years.
The bill provides a one-year postponement for interim decisions on benefit applications and an exemption for the final award thereof.
Het wetsvoorstel regelt uitstel voor één jaar voor tussentijdse beslissingen over verzoeken om toeslagen en afstel voor de definitieve toekenning daarvan.

Is critical of the government's delay and its financial-legal framing, argues the government has known since 2004 that the regime was coming, questions the inflated risk estimate, and says a further postponement beyond 2013 would not get its support.
Does the government realise that for seven years it was clear that a default-penalty regime was coming?
Realiseert de regering zich dat al zeven jaar lang duidelijk was dat er een dwangsomregeling aan zat te komen?
Proposes an alternative adjusted default-penalty regime with longer decision periods and lower penalties for 2012 and 2013, arguing legal certainty for citizens should be protected.
Statutory time limits in administrative law also aim to create legal certainty, according to the PVV members.
Wettelijke termijnen beogen in het bestuursrecht ook rechtszekerheid te scheppen, aldus de leden van de fractie van de PVV.
Asks whether exempting final awards from the regime impedes fraud control and whether taxpayers facing years of waiting for final assessments are adequately protected.
Precisely for the final award, the CDA members see problems.
Juist voor de definitieve toekenning zien de leden van de CDA-fractie problemen.
Requests the underlying calculations of the default-penalty risk estimates and asks whether the agency can actually meet statutory deadlines and what quality effects that would have.
They do, however, miss the underlying calculations of the amounts.
Zij missen daarbij wel de onderliggende berekeningen van de bedragen.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division supports the bill delaying application of the dwangsomregeling to toeslagen by one year, but raises objections to excluding definitive toeslag decisions and to the ministerial power to suspend the penalty scheme, asking for adaptation. The government's nader rapport accepts the advice, substantiates the exclusion, and amends the bill text to require a demonstrable massive claim risk from a serious disruption and a fixed suspension period.
concerns: The Afdeling asks that the bill's text on suspending the dwangsom scheme reflect the stated temporary and strictly limited purpose, which the government adopted by adding conditions and a fixed term.

The Afdeling finds the justification for excluding definitive toeslag decisions from the dwangsom scheme insufficiently reasoned and questions the link to the penalty amount; the government expanded the reasoning but kept the exclusion.

The Afdeling stresses the individual's interest in timely decisions and asks the explanatory memorandum to address the tension with mass automated processing; the government addressed this in the memorandum without removing the exclusion.
Redactional and technical improvements to the bill and explanatory memorandum were made following the advice.

33014.s: The bill amends the Dutch childcare and playgroup quality act, mainly tightening childcare allowance eligibility, background checks, inspection reporting, and inspection frequency for host-parent care, and removing the former national supervision arrangement in favour of municipal supervision. It also requires municipalities to supply information to the minister under a ministerial regulation.
33014.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by pointing to the need for detailed quality and information rules, the fraud and abuse problem in childcare allowance, and the need to keep the minister informed to fulfil his responsibility for the system.
q: Fourthly, the obligation is removed that all host-parent childcare facilities be inspected annually by the GGD.
In de vierde plaats wordt de verplichting geschrapt dat alle voorzieningen voor gastouderopvang jaarlijks door de GGD worden gecontroleerd.
d: childcare allowance and municipal/UWV compensation for periods of non-entitlement
quality rules for childcare centres (safety, staffing, pedagogy, premises)
maximum hours parents can be obliged to purchase per day
minimum annual support hours a host-parent agency provides
information municipalities must provide on supervision and enforcement
information municipalities must provide on playgroup supervision
p: Annual inspection of every host-parent facility is replaced by sample-based inspection on a risk profile, reducing the supervisory check on those facilities.
The specific national supervision arrangement over municipalities is removed, leaving only general municipal-law instruments such as indeplaatsstelling for the minister to intervene.

parties: Asks whether municipalities will process registrations quickly enough so parents are not harmed by the one-month retroactivity limit, and how municipal decisions based on other findings will work.
They want to prevent this from taking several months.
Zij willen voorkomen dat dit een aantal maanden duurt.
Asks for an exception where parents could not claim on time due to special circumstances, and questions whether the three-month limit is too short, especially for children in a bad labour market.
