If parents were unable to apply for the allowance on time due to special circumstances, an exception should be possible, the PvdA members think.
Als ouders door bijzondere omstandigheden niet in staat waren om de toeslag op tijd aan te vragen moet er een uitzondering kunnen worden gemaakt, vinden de leden van de PvdA-fractie.
Asks what risks arise from sample-based GGD inspections and how municipal grounds for refusing registration will be defined.
How are the resulting risks controlled?
Op welke wijze worden de hieruit voortvloeiende risico's beheerst?

Supports the changes but warns that reduced GGD inspection and possible municipal budget cuts could weaken oversight of poorly performing childminding agencies, and asks about parents' say and cross-municipality refusals.
According to the SP members, it would be desirable to visit well-functioning childminding agencies somewhat less, while tightening supervision of poorly performing ones.

Het zou volgens de leden van de SP-fractie juist wenselijk zijn om kwalitatief goed lopende gastouderbureaus iets minder te bezoeken, maar daarbij juist het toezicht op de kwalitatief slecht draaiende gastouderbureaus te verscherpen.
Asks whether inspection of childminding agencies will be intensified to compensate for dropping annual GGD visits to individual childminders.
These members are curious whether and to what extent inspection of childminding agencies will be intensified as compensation.
Deze leden zijn benieuwd of en in hoeverre de inspectie op gastouderbureaus wordt geïntensiveerd ter compensatie.

Questions why the retroactivity limit is one month rather than three, and worries that the hours-documentation requirement for self-employed parents will create confusion for them and the tax authority.
Is the government willing to limit the possibility of retroactive childcare benefit claims to three months?
Is de regering bereid om de mogelijkheid om met terugwerkende kracht kinderopvangtoeslag te beperken tot drie maanden?
Asks how many fraud cases occur per year, whether alternatives to abolishing retroactive claims were considered, and what effect the three-month limit will have on parents' job search.
If alternatives were considered, which alternatives were they and why was the choice not made in favour of them?
Indien er alternatieven zijn overwogen, om welke alternatieven gaat het dan en waarom is de keuze niet op deze alternatieven gevallen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the Verzamelwet SZW 2012 bundles technical and substantive changes across social security, pensions and childcare without sufficient thematic coherence, and asked the government to justify the omnibus approach or adapt the bill. The government's reply reports that the bill was split into three separate bills (pensions, childcare, SZW) and that some technical corrections were made.
concerns: The omnibus bill mixes technical and substantive amendments without thematic coherence, so it does not meet the criteria for omnibus legislation; the Afdeling asked for justification or adaptation.

Editorial remarks in the annex, including the question of how entitlement holders can learn they may still request a decision for child benefit at ages 6 and 12, and aligning Besluit article 6 with the amended Pensioenwet article 61.

33023.s: The bill amends the Dutch financial supervision act (Wft) and the financial reporting supervision act (Wtfv) to implement the amended EU prospectus and transparency directives. It raises several exemption thresholds from EUR 50,000 to EUR 100,000 and changes qualified investor, prospectus validity, summary, and disclosure rules.
33023.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as implementation of EU directive 2010/73/EU and says the threshold is kept at EUR 2.5 million to avoid more exempt offerings.
q: To achieve this aim, the Prospectus Directive requires member states to make offers of securities to the public or admissions to trading conditional on publication of a prospectus approved by a competent supervisor or supervisory authority of another member state.

Om dit doel te bereiken, verplicht de richtlijn prospectus lidstaten om aanbiedingen van effecten aan het publiek of toelatingen van effecten tot de handel op een in een lidstaat gelegen of functionerende gereglementeerde markt, afhankelijk te stellen van de publicatie van een prospectus dat is goedgekeurd door een bevoegde toezichthouder of toezichthoudende instantie van een andere lidstaat.

parties: Asks the government for the basis of the 150-investor figure, the reasons for not raising the EUR 2.5 million threshold, the effects on Dutch competitiveness, and an estimate of higher compliance costs.
Why does the government choose not to raise this threshold amount, ask the members of the VVD faction.
Waarom kiest de regering ervoor om dit drempelbedrag niet te verhogen, zo vragen de leden va de VVD-fractie.

Asks whether implementing the directive actually improves the prospectus situation and what drives the EUR 10 million reduction in administrative burden, and requests an overview of the chosen omnibus-style headings with reasons.
Can the government also indicate to what extent the implementation of the directive actually improves the situation regarding the prospectus?
Kan de regering hierbij echter ook aangeven in hoeverre door de implementatie van de richtlijn de situatie ten opzichte van de prospectus ook daadwerkelijk verbetert?

Supports not raising the EUR 2.5 million threshold but asks why it was raised in other states, what the Netherlands did to prevent this, whether lowering it is preferable given problems with the EUR 50,000 threshold, and whether a committed 1 January 2012 entry into force will be honoured.
The members of the SP faction support the choice not to raise the EUR 2.5 million threshold in Dutch law and regulations.
De leden van de SP-fractie steunen de keuze om de grens van € 2,5 miljoen in de Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving niet op te trekken.

33050.s: The bill amends the Dutch Medical Examinations Act to allow complaints about pre-employment medical examinations to be handled by an independent complaints committee possibly placed with the Social-Economic Council, adjusts insurance question limits and makes technical wording changes. It rewrites the general administrative order delegation in article 14, under which detailed rules on examinations and complaint handling are set, and repeals the evaluation provision in article 15.
33050.j: The memorandum justifies the general administrative order by noting that self-regulation by representative organisations did not materialise within the three-year period, so state rules were set by the 2001 Besluiten.
q: Because self-regulation on pre-employment examinations and their complaint handling did not materialise, rules were set in 2001 on the proposal of the State Secretary under article 14 Wmk.

Vanwege het uitblijven van zelfregulering met betrekking tot aanstellingskeuringen en de klachtenbehandeling ervan zijn op voordracht van de Staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid in 2001 op grond van artikel 14 Wmk nadere regels gesteld.
d: rules on conducting pre-employment examinations and health questions
establishment, procedure and publication of independent complaints committee
periodic indexation of insurance question limits to consumer price index

parties: Asks how compliance with the ban on health questions in job applications can be checked and how well employees know the rule.
The VVD members ask how compliance is ensured so that, for example, job applicants are not asked about health and sick leave during applications.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe er wordt nageleefd dat er bijvoorbeeld bij sollicitaties niet naar zaken als de gezondheid en het ziekteverzuim kan worden gevraagd.
Questions why the government keeps flexibility to reassign the complaints commission while removing the evaluation obligation, and asks for rules on the commission's working method.
Why does the government want flexibility in the law to move the Cka competence back to the minister, while on the other hand choosing to remove the evaluation obligation from the law?

Waarom wil de regering enerzijds flexibiliteit in de wet, om zo de bevoegdheid over de Cka weer terug bij de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (SZW) onder te brengen, terwijl de regering er anderzijds voor kiest de evaluatieplicht uit de wet te verwijderen?
Questions the choice to house the complaints commission at the SER, suggests alternatives, and asks how a balanced composition will be ensured.
The PVV members ask why the choice has been made to place the Cka with the SER.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen waarom er wordt gekozen voor onderbrenging van de Cka bij de SER.
Supports the SER's central role but asks why the government wants to keep the option to withdraw the task from the SER at any time.
The explanatory memorandum states that the government explicitly wants to retain the flexibility to no longer assign the task of establishing the complaints commission to the SER at any moment.

In de memorie van toelichting wordt aangegeven dat de regering uitdrukkelijk de flexibiliteit wil behouden om de taak om de klachtencommissie in te stellen op enig moment niet meer aan de SER op te dragen.
Asks why the government will not evaluate the Wmk further and what additional measures exist to enforce the ban on lay examinations.
The ChristenUnie members ask for an explanation of why the government refrains from further evaluations of the Wmk, since lay examinations still regularly occur.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen een nadere toelichting waarom de regering afziet van verdere evaluaties van de Wmk, aangezien lekenkeuringen nog steeds regelmatig voorkomen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports a bill amending the Medical Examinations Act, but raises objections to the vague framework for handling complaints about pre-employment examinations (assigning this to the SER) and to the ban on lay examinations, advising revision before proceeding. The government's reply accepts the drafting remark on the SER's task and adds a justification for the amended lay-examination wording, but keeps flexibility on the SER role and rejects the suggested redactional changes to articles 13 and 14.
concerns: The Council found the statutory basis for the SER's task to establish the complaints committee too vague and advised stating the SER's task explicitly in the Act; the government kept the flexibility to assign it differently later.
The Council found no justification that the amended wording on the ban on lay examinations would significantly improve compliance; the government added an explanation in the explanatory memorandum.

The Council suggested positively defining in article 13 which types of examinations the complaints committee covers, and deleting a phrase in article 14 and sharpening the delegation clause; the government did not adopt these redactional remarks.

33212.s: The bill abolishes municipal and UWV childcare contributions and folds them into the national childcare allowance administered by the Belastingdienst/Toeslagen, with budget cuts. It also removes the delegation for setting the municipal contribution by ministerial regulation, leaving that to municipal discretion.
33212.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly on the need to make budget cuts in childcare allowance and to align administration with the Belastingdienst/Toeslagen, and says municipal contribution rules fit municipal policy competence.
q: We have considered that it is desirable to make it possible to implement cuts in the childcare allowance in order to put government finances in order

Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het wenselijk is om het mogelijk te maken bezuinigingen door te voeren met betrekking tot de kinderopvangtoeslag teneinde de overheidsfinanciën op orde te brengen
d: rules on providing the unique number for the childcare allowance
ratio between working hours, activation hours and childcare hours entitling to allowance
I, I (artikel 1.8, eerste en tweede lid)
amount, calculation and fixed own contribution of the childcare allowance
annual indexation of amounts and income-dependence via index designated by amvb
setting the premium surcharges financing the childcare allowance
p: Key parameters of the childcare allowance, including the fixed own contribution, are moved from statute to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations, with indexation set outside parliament.
Power to levy premium surcharges to finance the allowance is created and their amounts are set by ministerial regulation.
Municipalities may impose administrative fines of up to EUR 45,000 on childcare providers that breach obligations, orders or prohibitions.
The municipal supplementary contribution becomes discretionary rather than an obligation, and the ministerial rule-setting power for it is removed, leaving eligibility to municipal policy.

parties: Asks when the AMvB implementing the measures will come and whether it has a prior-consultation (voorhang) procedure, i.e. parliamentary oversight of delegated rules.

Can the government explain to the VVD members whether all announced measures will be set out in one and the same General Administrative Order (AMvB)? And whether this AMvB still has a prior-consultation procedure?

Kan de regering aan de leden van de VVD-fractie toelichten of al de aangekondigde maatregelen in één en dezelfde Algemene Maatregel van Bestuur (AMvB) worden aangekondigd? En of deze AMvB nog een voorhangprocedure kent?
Questions why the measures are not realised together with the bill and how and when they will be implemented through delegated regulation, and asks how the Chamber will be informed.
Why are the planned cuts and reforms not being realised at the same time as this bill?
Waarom worden de voorgenomen bezuinigingen en hervormingen niet gelijktijdig met dit wetsvoorstel gerealiseerd?
Questions the deferral of the concrete figures to a later amendment of the Besluit KOT, the lack of alternatives considered, and asks for the draft amendment to be sent to the Chamber promptly.
The CDA members ask the government to send the (draft) amendment of the Besluit KOT to the Chamber as soon as possible, so it can be included in the underlying legislative process.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering om de (concept)wijziging van het Besluit KOT zo spoedig mogelijk naar de Kamer te zenden, zodat deze kan worden meegenomen bij het onderliggende wetgevingstraject.
Stresses that the delegations should be limited to a minimum and asks for timely information to the Chamber on how they will be filled in.
The members also explicitly ask the government to inform the Chamber in good time about how these delegations will be filled in, and strongly urge limiting these delegations to a minimum.

Ook willen de leden de regering nadrukkelijk verzoeken de Kamer tijdig te informeren over de wijze waarop hier invulling aan wordt gegeven en geven de regering nadrukkelijk in overweging deze delegaties tot een minimum te beperken

Objects to cutting rather than improving efficiency and asks whether municipalities' discretion over the koa-kopje could leave some parents without childcare support, raising concern about protection of parents.
Does this situation remain under municipalities' policy discretion through the so-called koa-kopje? And if so, does the government consider that a desirable situation?
Blijft het zo dat deze situatie onder de beleidsvrijheid van gemeenten valt door middel van het zogenoemde koa-kopje? En zo ja, acht de regering dat een wenselijke situatie?
Asks for explanation of which delegated regulation is used and why measures were not submitted together with the bill.
Why was it not chosen to submit the additional measures at the same time as the bill?
Waarom is er niet voor gekozen om de aanvullende maatregelen gelijktijdig met het wetsvoorstel in te dienen?

33221.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the Treaty establishing the European Stability Mechanism signed in Brussels on 2 February 2012, which requires parliamentary approval under Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
33221.j: The memorandum argues that the ESM's intergouvernemental control is adequate because national audit offices and the European Court of Auditors take part in an external audit committee, and that any capital increase amending the treaty will itself be submitted to parliamentary approval.
q: For the Netherlands this means that such amendments will be subject to parliamentary approval.
Voor Nederland betekent dit dat dergelijke wijzigingen aan een parlementaire goedkeuring zullen worden onderworpen.
d: Board of Governors may decide to increase ESM capital and amend the treaty

parties: Asks how parliament is involved in ESM decisions in normal and emergency situations, and how the IMF is involved in operations.

Can the government, per category of decision-making (granting support, increasing capital and calling the unpaid Dutch capital), indicate in a normal situation and in an emergency how parliamentary involvement is organised?

Kan de regering per categorie van besluitvorming (verlenen van steun, verhogen maatschappelijk kapitaal en opvragen van het nog niet volgestorte Nederlandse kapitaal) in een normale situatie en in een noodsituatie aangeven hoe de parlementaire betrokkenheid wordt vormgegeven
Supports the ESM but wants prior informing of parliament on key decisions, a strong independent Board of Auditors, and clarity on capital calls subject to parliamentary budget right.
As a general principle, the PvdA members push for the Finance Minister to inform the House in advance of matters that should be submitted to the House in his view or in the House's view.

Als algemeen principe zetten de leden van de PvdA-fractie in op het vooraf informeren van de Tweede Kamer door de minister van Financiën over zaken die naar zijn oordeel of het oordeel van de Tweede Kamer voorgelegd moeten worden.
Supports the ESM and welcomes strong audit involvement, but asks detailed questions on governance, central bank involvement, and the role of national audit offices.
The CDA members are also pleased that the control has been made as strong as possible.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn ook verheugd over het feit dat de controle zo sterk mogelijk is gemaakt.
Opposes this specific fund and the hasty ratification, questions the immunities of ESM officials and the lack of parliamentary role in the bill.
In addition, these members strongly object to the careless and hasty manner in which it is being introduced.
Daarnaast maken deze leden ernstig bezwaar tegen de onzorgvuldige en overhaaste manier waarop het wordt ingevoerd.
Worries that the intergovernmental design sidesteps EU checks and balances and that democratic control by Parliament, the European Parliament and the Court is unclear.
The D66 members attach great importance to democratic control and see the current treaty as an intermediate stage.
De leden van de D66-fractie hechten groot belang aan de democratische controle en zien het huidige verdrag als een tussenstation.
Questions whether parliament has a decisive say over disbursements given the lack of a Dutch veto under the emergency procedure, and whether democratic control of the ESM is sufficiently secured.
But who can hold the Dutch parliament to account for the functioning of the ESM if the Dutch finance minister has been sidelined in the emergency voting procedure due to the lack of a veto?

Maar wie kan het Nederlandse parlement aanspreken of het functioneren van het ESM als de Nederlandse minister van Financiën in de spoedstemprocedure wegens het gebrek aan een veto buiten spel is komen te staan
Asks when a state of emergency arises, who determines it, and how IMF involvement and the qualified majority rules work in practice.
When is there an emergency situation and who determines this, the PVV members ask?
Wanneer is sprake van een noodsituatie en door wie wordt dit bepaald, zo vragen de leden van de PVV-fractie?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the ESM Treaty bill but raises concerns about its intergovernmental structure, lack of EU-level democratic and judicial control, and the role of the Staten-Generaal in capital calls and capital increases, advising proceeding with revisions to the explanatory memorandum. The minister's reply accepts most points, adding clarifications on the treaty's relation to Article 136 TFEU, explaining that national parliamentary and audit controls compensate for EU-level gaps, and expanding the explanatory memorandum on the parliamentary procedure for ESM support operations and capital increases.
concerns: The Afdeling objects that the intergovernmental ESM bypasses EU institutional checks and balances and asks how its powers relate to those in the TFEU; the government addressed this in the explanatory memorandum but disagrees that the ESM should be a transitional stage toward integration.

The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to explain differences between the ESM Treaty text and Article 136(3) TFEU, such as financial stability of the eurozone and preventive assistance, which the government added.

The Afdeling advises that the Staten-Generaal must be involved in decisions to effectuate the Dutch financial claim and that the behavioural procedure for ESM support operations be specified, which the government supplemented.

The Afdeling advises clarifying that any increase of ESM capital requires explicit parliamentary approval under Article 91(1) of the Constitution before Dutch consent, which the government addressed in the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling makes a redactional remark on the priority ranking of IMF, ESM and European programme claims relative to statutory priority of other claims, which was addressed in the memorandum.

33302.s: The bill amends the Gemeentewet and Provinciewet to require that the budget balance be 'structural and real' (structureel en reëel evenwicht) rather than just 'balanced', and to drop the ground for preventive supervision based on a non-balanced annual account. It also lets the supervisory authority (Gedeputeerde Staten for municipalities, the Minister for provinces) withdraw preventive supervision during the budget year, reducing supervisory burden.
33302.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by reducing supervisory and administrative burden on municipalities and provinces and by clarifying the notion of balance for horizontal accountability.
q: The possibility is introduced to end preventive supervision during the year, and the possibility to impose preventive supervision on the basis of a deficit in the annual account is also removed.

De mogelijkheid wordt geïntroduceerd om het preventieve toezicht in de loop van het jaar te beëindigen, en tevens wordt de mogelijkheid voor het instellen van preventief toezicht op grond van een tekort op de jaarrekening geschrapt.
p: Artikel I B, Gemeentewet art. 203 (lid 5) and Artikel II B, Provinciewet art. 207 (lid 5)

Gedeputeerde Staten or the Minister may withdraw preventive financial supervision during the budget year, which reduces oversight of municipalities and provinces but is a supervisory-power change rather than an expansion of executive discretion.

parties: Asks for justification of removing preventive supervision and whether earlier insight into municipal financial problems is needed given EMU balance and land-development risks.
These members therefore ask the government to further justify this proposal.
Deze leden vragen de regering dan ook dit voorstel nader te motiveren.
Asks how the wider framework for financial supervision relates to the bill, citing the Rfv's view that a shared vision is lacking, and asks for stress tests and criteria for supervision.
In addition, these members want to know when the announced new common supervisory framework will be published.
Daarnaast willen deze leden weten wanneer het aangekondigde nieuwe gemeenschappelijk toezichtkader gepubliceerd zal worden.
Asks whether financial risks with long-term effects are covered and whether an evaluation mechanism exists, and asks for comparability of figures so parliament can exercise its control task.
They ask whether these measures cover financial risks that could have negative long-term consequences.
Zij vragen of met deze maatregelen financiële risico’s worden afgedekt, die op de lange termijn negatieve gevolgen kunnen hebben.

Asks for concrete meaning of the replaced 'structural and real balance' concept, timing of the BBV and GTK revisions, and the Rfv's suggestions including stress tests and a preventive trigger when reserves are too low.
These members request the government to send the BBV and GTK to the House together with the response memorandum so both can be considered in assessing the bill.

Deze leden verzoeken de regering het BBV en het GTK tegelijk met de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag aan de Kamer toe te zenden, zodat beide kunnen worden betrokken bij de beoordeling van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Asks why the changes are necessary, what problems the current supervision provisions cause, and how the bill solves them.
They wonder why these changes are necessary.
Zij vragen zich af waarom deze wijzigingen noodzakelijk zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill limiting financial supervision of municipalities and provinces but advises anchoring the criteria for balanced budgets (structural and real balance) in the law itself and guarding against late intervention. The government's reply accepts the advice, adding the criteria to the Gemeentewet and Provinciewet and specifying them in the GTK and BBV.
concerns: The Afdeling advises that the criteria for balanced municipal and provincial budgets be set out in the statute rather than only in the BBV, because horizontal supervision of autonomous powers warrants formal legal regulation.

The Afdeling notes that replacing 'material balance' with 'structural and real balance' gives flexibility that could lead to late intervention and asks for safeguards against assessment errors, which the government answers by pointing to the BBV, GTK and sequential assessment rather than new safeguards.
The Afdeling makes a redactional remark on the numbering of article members in article II, which has been corrected.

33320.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2008/52/EC on mediation in cross-border civil and commercial matters into Dutch law. It defines mediation and cross-border disputes, allows courts to propose mediation, provides confidentiality and limitation-period rules, and makes settlements enforceable.
33320.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as necessary to implement the directive; it does not justify any delegation or new executive power.
q: Under Dutch law the court cannot order mediation and there is no obligation to mediate.
Naar Nederlands recht kan de rechter geen mediation bevelen en bestaat er geen verplichting tot mediation.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a draft bill implementing the EU mediation directive 2008/52/EG, restricting the mediator confidentiality and limitation-suspension rules to cross-border cases, and recommended converting the novelle into a standalone act and dropping or narrowing transitional law. The government's reply adopted the advice: the bill is now a standalone act, transitional provisions were removed, and entry into force is the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
concerns: The novelle amending boek 3 BW and Rv should be presented as a standalone act to avoid confusion between title, considerans and body; the government followed this.

The proposed transitional law for mediations ongoing at entry into force has no basis in the directive and should be dropped, or at least limited to mediations begun before 21 May 2011; the government removed it.
Entry into force by royal decree should be replaced by entry into force the day after publication, given the urgency of implementation; the government followed this.
Redactional remarks in the annex on the definitions of lidstaat and the richtlijn in article 1 were incorporated.

33400-IIB.s: This bill fixes the 2013 budget statement (begrotingsstaat IIB) for the remaining High Colleges of State and the Governors' cabinets, setting expenditure and revenue figures for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden and the Governors' cabinets of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten. The bill itself contains no delegation of rule-making power; the accompanying explanatory memorandum describes the agencies' tasks and budget developments.
q: Article 1: The budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2013 is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2013 wordt vastgesteld.

34013.s: The bill transfers the decision on an internal body search of a person held or to be held in a police cell from the police to the public prosecutor (officier van justitie), and adjusts the related provisions for the Royal Military Police. It also repeals a transitional provision in the Verzamelwet Veiligheid en Justitie 2013 that is no longer needed.
34013.j: The memorandum justifies the change as following Eerste Kamer requests and a Raad van State recommendation to place the decision with a high judicial authority, and notes the need for a body search is expected to be rare.
q: First, I propose to delete that any staff member of the police station or cell complex may make the decision referred to here.
Ten eerste stel ik voor om te schrappen dat iedere medewerker van het politiebureau of het cellencomplex de hier bedoelde beslissing mag nemen
d: officier van justitie decides whether a body search is necessary
entry into force by royal decree, possibly staggered per article
p: The decision to order an internal body search moves from police leadership to the public prosecutor, a judicial-level authority, narrowing the discretion of police officers and adding a higher-level check.'

parties: Asks who makes the decision in practice and how emergency procedures work, probing the oversight and decision-making safeguards for bodily searches.
Those members further ask how the procedure works in an emergency, either regarding the health of the detainee or the safety of others present.

Voornoemde leden vragen voorts hoe de procedure verloopt als er sprake is van een noodsituatie, hetzij ten aanzien van de gezondheid van de gedetineerde, hetzij ten aanzien van de veiligheid van andere aanwezigen.
Asks why the prosecutor rather than the investigating judge (rechtercommissaris) takes this serious decision, pointing to an amendment from the Eerste Kamer that proposed the judge.
What led the government to place this far-reaching decision with the public prosecutor rather than the investigating judge?
Wat heeft de regering doen besluiten deze ingrijpende beslissing bij de officier van justitie te leggen en niet bij de rechtercommissaris?
Supports the change but asks whether the requirement to wait for prosecutorial approval conflicts with urgency, risks of concealed items, and whether doctors may refuse.
They ask, however, whether the urgency required is precisely what would justify a difference here.
Zij vragen echter of de geboden spoed niet juist hetgeen is wat hier een verschil zou rechtvaardigden?
Asks whether a replacement decision-maker should be designated for emergencies, since the bill no longer provides for substitution.
Unforeseen circumstances can always arise, and these members therefore ask whether, to be safe, someone should still be authorised to take the decision in an emergency.
Er kunnen zich altijd onvoorziene omstandigheden voordoen en deze leden vragen daarom of toch beter voor de zekerheid in geval van nood nog iemand bevoegd moet zijn de beslissing te nemen.

34022.s: The bill amends several Dutch education laws (primary, secondary, special and vocational education, expertise centres, participation law, inspection law) to refine passend onderwijs rules, including orthopedagogical-didactic centres, individual deviations from minimum instruction hours, development perspectives, and participation rights of the support plan council. Most changes are technical or clarifying, delegating detailed conditions to general administrative orders.
34022.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly as needed to clarify rules and restore earlier arrangements, with detailed conditions to be set in general administrative orders.
q: It concerns various technical or minor policy changes.
Het betreft verschillende technische of kleine beleidsmatige wijzigingen.
d: implementation and requirements for schools in primary education
implementation and requirements for schools in secondary special education
conditions for establishing orthopedagogical-didactic centres in secondary education
amount of withheld funding when cooperation agreement is terminated early
rules on student monitoring system and associated tests
amount of teacher staffing per pupil
ARTIKEL II D (art. 14a(2)(e) WEC) and II E (art. 25(5) WEC)
inspectorate consent to deviation from minimum instruction hours
p: ARTIKEL II D and E (art. 14a(2)(e), 25(5) WEC)
The inspectorate may, on request of the school board, consent to deviating from the statutory minimum instruction hours for individual special education pupils.
Ministerial power to determine amounts withheld from funding when cooperation agreements end early is set by general administrative order.

parties: Asks how schools working with many collaborative partnerships can handle split funding and whether this is workable in practice.
Does the government consider that workable in implementation, the members ask.
Acht de regering dat, in de uitvoering, werkbaar, zo vragen de leden.
Supports the technical changes and asks for a timeline for a follow-up bill implementing the Ypma motion on parental agreement.
These last technical amendments to smooth the implementation of passend onderwijs have the members' support.
Deze laatste technische wijzigingen om de uitvoering van passend onderwijs soepel te laten verlopen, heeft de steun van de leden.
Questions whether pupils may be forced out of an orthopedagogical centre after two years and asks about the risk of shortages of special schools and closures for financial reasons.
What happens if these pupils are still unable to do so after two years?
Wat gebeurt er als deze leerlingen daar na twee jaar nog steeds niet toe in staat zijn?
Asks how schools must justify individual deviations from the instruction-hours norm to parents and the Inspectorate, and asks about experience with the temporary national dispute committee.
They would welcome further explanation of which pupils this applies to and how the school must justify it to parents and the Inspectorate of Education.
Graag ontvangen zij een nadere toelichting voor welke leerlingen dit geldt en hoe de school dit moet motiveren richting ouders en de Inspectie van het Onderwijs.
Notes that the broadened psychische handicap category for pupil transport is unclear for municipalities and asks the government to explain its claim that demand will not rise.
Can the government explain this statement in more detail, they ask.
Kan de regering deze uitspraak nader toelichten, zo vragen zij.
Questions why person-specific registration of pupils is justified as a serious general interest when monitoring data are anonymised and aggregated, raising privacy concerns.

Asks whether the constitutional duty of municipalities to provide public education survives autonomisation of schools and whether the support-plan council may convert powers as the participation council may.
Does the government share the view of these members that it would be desirable to give concrete effect to the constitutional obligation of municipalities in education legislation
Deelt de regering de mening van deze leden dat het wenselijk zou zijn de grondwettelijke verplichting van gemeenten concreet uitwerking te geven in de onderwijswetgeving

34031.s: The bill adds provisions to the Primary Education Act and the Expertise Centres Act allowing part of instruction to be given in English, German or French, as an exception to the Dutch or Frisian language rule. The maximum percentage of instruction time per school year in those languages will be set by general administrative order (AMvB).
34031.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB route because the time share may need adjusting in future, which is easier to do by amending an AMvB than a statute, citing the bilingual primary education pilot.
q: This construction was chosen because it is foreseen that in the future it may be desirable to adjust the amount of instruction time in which English, German or French may be used as a partial language.

Voor deze constructie is gekozen, omdat voorzien wordt dat het in de toekomst gewenst kan zijn om de hoeveelheid onderwijstijd aan te passen, waarin het Engels, Duits of Frans als deelvoertaal mag worden gebruikt.
d: maximum percentage of instruction time in English, German or French per school year
maximum percentage of instruction time in English, German or French per school year

parties: Asks about job prospects for pupils, legal obstacles to exchanges, insurance problems and teacher training, without raising checks on the executive.
The VVD members have taken note of the bill with great approval.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met grote instemming kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel.
Asks how the quality of foreign-language teaching will be guaranteed and how current quality problems will be improved.
The PvdA members ask how the quality of education in English, German or French will be guaranteed.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen hoe de kwaliteit van het onderwijs in het Engels, Duits of Frans gewaarborgd gaat worden.
Asks about the pilot schools, outcomes for pupils with language disadvantage, and teacher competence and training.
The SP members note that the bill pays little attention to teachers' competence.
De leden van de SP-fractie merken op dat over de bekwaamheid van de leraren in het onderhavig wetsvoorstel weinig aandacht wordt besteed.
Asks whether works council consent is needed, how the Inspectorate will monitor results, and why French was chosen; asks about exceptions for individual pupils.
The CDA members ask the government to state whether introducing 15% instruction time in a modern foreign language requires consent or advisory rights of the school's works council.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering aan te geven of voor het invoeren van 15% onderwijstijd in een moderne vreemde taal instemmings- of adviesrecht nodig is van de medezeggenschapsraad van de desbetreffende school.
Asks why 15% was chosen as the limit, whether schools can exceed it, and how teacher competence can be raised.
Is it possible for schools to teach more than 15% of instruction time in English, German or French if quality and outcomes are in order?
Is het mogelijk voor scholen om meer dan 15% van de onderwijstijd in het Engels, Duits of Frans geven, indien daarmee de kwaliteit en opbrengsten op orde zijn?
Asks how teacher qualifications for foreign-language instruction and quality are safeguarded and how the 15% limit is measured.
The amendments do not address the required qualifications of teachers who will give lessons in a foreign language.
In de wetswijzigingen wordt niet ingegaan op de benodigde bevoegdheid van de leerkrachten die de lestijd in een vreemde taal gaan geven.
Objects that the bill gives an unqualified basis for foreign-language teaching without a statutory maximum percentage, and asks for better evidence and safeguards for Dutch.
These members ask why at least a maximum percentage for the use of foreign languages is not included in the proposal.
Deze leden vragen waarom niet tenminste een maximumpercentage voor het gebruik van vreemde talen in het voorstel wordt opgenomen.

34040.s: The bill establishes a Council for Public Health and Society as a standing advisory body to the government and both chambers of the States General on health and social policy. It also repeals the earlier laws on the Council for Public Health and Care and the Council for Social Development.
q: There is a Council for Public Health and Society.
Er is een Raad voor volksgezondheid en samenleving.

parties: Asks how the new council will reach a work programme with broad support, meets field needs and is sufficiently proactive, under the Kaderwet adviescolleges.

They have only one question about this proposal: how the RVS, within the competence it has under the Kaderwet adviescolleges, arrives at a work programme that has broad support, meets the needs from the field and is sufficiently proactive.

Zij hebben over voorliggend voorstel alleen nog de vraag hoe de Raad voor volksgezondheid en samenleving (RVS), binnen de bevoegdheid die hij geniet op grond van de Kaderwet adviescolleges, komt tot een werkprogramma dat een breed draagvlak heeft, beantwoordt aan de behoefte uit het veld en voldoende proactief is.

Doubts the independence of the new council, fears government-steered advice that masks critical voices, questions the chair's political ties and multiple roles, and notes the Raad van State warning about the council's broad remit.
The SP members see the trend that government advisory councils often serve to examine policy intentions for success.
De leden van de SP-fractie zien de trend dat adviescolleges van de regering vaak ten dienste staan om beleidsvoornemens tot succes te onderzoeken.

Asks the government to justify the merger, cites the Raad van State's criticism of missing problem analysis, and asks how decentralised experiences and whether the government will respond to council advice.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft Act establishing the Raad voor volksgezondheid en samenleving (RVS), merging the RVZ and RMO, and asked for better justification of the merger's added value, protection of the RMO's work field, an evaluation discussion, and personnel effects. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, added justification and clarifications to the explanatory memorandum, and removed the term 'welbevinden' from the task description.
concerns: The Council asked that the added value of merging the RVZ and RMO be adequately motivated, which the government addressed by expanding the explanatory memorandum while maintaining its view that merger improves integrality.
The Council asked that the RMO's existing work field be assured in the new council's remit, and the government clarified this in the memorandum without changing the task description.
The Council asked the explanatory memorandum to explain how experiences from decentralisation in health care will reach the new council, and the government added this in paragraph 3.
The Council advised deleting the term 'welbevinden' from the task description as adding little, and the government removed it.
The Council asked for discussion of mandatory four-yearly evaluations and the minister's letter on the advisory system, which the government added to paragraph 1.
The Council asked for an assessment of the merger's consequences for staffing, which the government added to paragraph 7.
A redactional remark on the role of the Centrum voor Ethiek en Gezondheid was incorporated into paragraph 2 of the memorandum.

34085-J.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds for 2014 through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments and expenditure across several articles, including a shift of 15 million euro for the Marker Wadden experiment. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and takes effect on 1 December 2014 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds for the year 2014
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds voor het jaar 2014

34112.s: The bill shortens the duration of continued benefits (voortgezette uitkering) for politically appointed office holders by amending the General Pension Act for political office holders, removing the ability to continue benefits to pension age for many former ministers, members of parliament, provincial executives and local officials. It adds transitional rules preserving the old regime for those already in office at entry into force and for certain reappointments.
34112.j: The memorandum justifies the bill by the need to improve the quality of public administration and the availability of qualified people for political office, and notes that a broader integrated vision on the legal position of political office holders will follow.
q: Public administration cannot function without the availability of qualified people willing to hold political office in the administration and representative bodies.

Het openbaar bestuur kan niet functioneren zonder de beschikbaarheid van gekwalificeerde mensen die bereid zijn om politieke functies te vervullen in het bestuur en in de volksvertegenwoordigende organen
d: entry into force by royal decree on a date set per article

parties: Asks why the bill was submitted before the promised integrated vision on the legal position of political office holders, and asks for clarity on transitional law and whether further cuts are off the table.
The VVD members read in the explanatory memorandum that the government will send the House an integrated vision on the nature and development of the legal position of political office holders.

In de memorie van toelichting lezen de leden van de VVD-fractie dat de regering een integrale visie op de aard en de ontwikkeling van de (rechts-)positie van de politieke ambtsdrager aan de Tweede Kamer zal doen toekomen.
Supports the reduction to five years as aligned with employees' entitlements, but asks whether the integrated vision will allow further cuts and whether disability arrangements will be included.
They can agree with the proposed reduction of the duration of the continued benefit from 10 to 5 years.
Zij kunnen zich vinden in de voorgestelde verkorting van de duur van de voortgezette uitkering van 10 naar 5 jaar.

Says key earlier questions were not answered satisfactorily, notably how many office holders receive the benefit and what changed compared with the earlier bill, and asks for a quantitative comparison of labour market prospects.
The government answered this question only for members of the House of Representatives, the Speaker of the Senate, ministers and the National Ombudsman, stating it has no further data.

Deze vraag heeft de regering enkel beantwoord waar het gaat om leden van de Tweede Kamer, voorzitter Eerste Kamer, bewindspersonen en de Nationale ombudsman omdat zij stelt niet over meer gegevens te beschikken.

Supports shortening the benefit but insists on an integrated vision on the political office and its legal position, and asks when it will be ready and whether it can be sent alongside the report response.
The CDA members therefore attach importance to an integrated vision of the political office and the associated legal position.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hechten daarom aan een integrale visie op het politieke ambt en de daarbij behorende rechtspositie.

Asks why the government did not wait for the integrated vision, when it expects to send it and whether the bill will be completed before 1 July 2015, and questions the planning and the reasons for delay.
Does the government value careful legislation, and has it taken this sufficiently into account in its planning?
Hecht de regering aan zorgvuldige wetgeving en heeft hij hier voldoende rekening mee gehouden in zijn planning?

Misses the promised integrated vision and asks why the bill could not await it, noting that exit and transition rules affect the willingness of qualified citizens to take political office; asks for data on office tenure and on the fund financing.
These members, however, miss the announced integrated vision on political office holders and have several questions about the content of the bill.
Deze leden missen echter de aangekondigde integrale visie op politieke ambtsdragers en hebben enkele vragen over de inhoud van het wetsvoorstel.
Views the bill as an ad hoc decision lacking an integrated vision, questions proportionality and the criteria for political office holders, and asks how the bill fits the stated principles.
The SGP members wonder whether this proposal again has the character of an ad hoc decision.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen zich af of dit voorstel niet opnieuw het karakter van een ad-hoc-beslissing draagt.
Finds it difficult to judge the proposed cut without the integrated vision, does not yet see a convincing justification, and asks for research on the labour market prospects of former office holders.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the explanatory memorandum to the bill shortening the transitional benefit for former political office holders should include an outline of the government's promised integral vision on their legal position, and that this vision be sent to parliament alongside the bill. The minister replied that the outline has been added but the full vision cannot yet be sent because consultations are ongoing, and that it will follow once ready.
concerns: The Afdeling advised adding an outline of the integral vision on the political office holder's legal position to the explanatory memorandum and sending the vision to parliament together with the bill; the government added an outline but cannot yet send the full vision.
The Afdeling proposed redactional changes to article I, part D, replacing references to dismissal with resignation and correcting the wording of the twelve-year period.

34130.s: The bill amends the primary, secondary and special-needs education acts to impose a statutory duty on school boards to ensure social safety at school, including a social safety policy, monitoring of pupils' safety with a representative instrument, and assignment of anti-bullying coordination and contact tasks to a designated person. It also requires the minister to report to parliament within five years on the effectiveness of these duties, and the explanatory memorandum notes the inspectorate's supervisory role.
34130.j: The memorandum justifies the statutory duty by the weak implicit basis for inspectorate supervision and the need for enforceable accountability of school boards on social safety.
q: Through statutory anchoring, the inspectorate is placed in a position to effectively supervise social safety at schools and, where there is reason, can act with enforcement.
Door wettelijke verankering komt de inspectie in positie om effectief toezicht te houden op de sociale veiligheid op scholen, en indien daar aanleiding toe is, kan zij handhavend optreden.

parties: Asks whether the inspectorate can already enforce, how sanctions work, and whether the obligation is an effort or result obligation, given the Council of State's doubts on necessity.
These members refer to earlier debates on this subject and ask the government whether that is correct.
De leden verwijzen naar eerdere debatten over dit onderwerp en vragen aan de regering of dat waar is.
Asks about monitoring effectiveness, inclusion of vocational education, and the role of teachers and other actors in the anti-bullying plan.
Asks what existing provisions are removed, how often sanctions were applied, and whether the inspectorate's juridical basis is adequate.
The SP members ask which provisions in the current law will be deleted now that a clear duty of care is being laid down in the law.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen welke bepalingen in de huidige wet worden geschrapt nu er een duidelijke zorgplicht in de wet wordt vastgelegd.
Doubts the bill's necessity and fears a paper tiger and tick-box culture, citing the Council of State's and Onderwijsraad's criticism.
Objects that schools and umbrella bodies may keep using anti-bullying programmes not proven effective, and questions the bill's enforceability and the Onderwijsraad's advice.
The members place large question marks over the rest of the bill, since implementing social safety policy in practice cannot and may not take shape through the education umbrella organisations.
De leden zetten grote vraagtekens bij de rest van het wetsvoorstel aangezien het voeren van sociaal veiligheidsbeleid in de praktijk nu al geen gestalte kan en mag krijgen van de onderwijskoepels.
Asks for clear definitions, the sanctions and compliance tests, the role of the works council, and the evaluation design, seeking clearer accountability.
For schools it is of great importance that it is completely clear when they comply with the law.
Voor scholen is het van groot belang dat het volkomen helder is wanneer zij voldoen aan de wet.
Asks whether the bill is justified against the Onderwijsraad's advice and the Dijsselbloem test, and whether it creates an implicit obligation to use proven methods and a single coordinator.
Is the government willing to test this bill against both the Onderwijsraad's recommendations and the Dijsselbloem committee's assessment framework?
Is de regering bereid om voorliggend wetsvoorstel te toetsen aan zowel de aanbevelingen van de Onderwijsraad als het toetsingskader van de commissie-Dijsselbloem?
Warns the duty of care is vague but potentially far-reaching, may extend school liability and burden schools, and questions the inspectorate's monitoring and sanction powers.
The current implicit regulation of safety policy is replaced by a duty of care whose scope is unclear but whose consequences could be far-reaching.
De huidige impliciete regeling van het veiligheidsbeleid wordt namelijk vervangen door een zorgplicht waarvan het bereik onduidelijk is, maar waarvan de gevolgen verstrekkend kunnen zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against sending the bill on school social safety to parliament in its current form, questioning the need for an additional statutory duty given existing school-guide and inspectorate powers. The government's reply largely accepted the drafting remarks (replacing 'waarborgen' with 'zorg dragen') and the inclusion of the 'delegation' issue on vocational education, but rejected the main necessity objection, arguing the inspectorate lacks adequate enforcement basis under current law.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether an additional statutory duty on social safety is useful and necessary given existing school-guide obligations and inspectorate powers.
The Afdeling objected that a duty to 'waarborgen' social safety is a result obligation beyond schools' capacity; the government replaced it with 'zorg dragen' as an inspanningsverplichting.
The Afdeling noted redundancy in the proposed articles (the phrase 'waaronder het tegengaan van pesten'), which was deleted.
The Afdeling asked why the Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs was excluded; the government added a justification and supplemented the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asked for a fuller account of consultation with Caribbean Netherlands school boards; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.
The Afdeling asked for justification of the administrative burden figures; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.
The Afdeling asked for an outline of a quasi-experimental evaluation design; the government said details would follow later with independent expert advice.

34210-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget (first supplementary budget) for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, National Ombudsman and the governors' cabinets of Aruba, Curacao and Sint Maarten, adjusting expenditure and receipts by a few million euros. The accompanying memorandum explains the budget changes, mainly for ICT investment at the Raad van State and a shared digital content purchase.
q: The budget statement for the other High Councils of State and the Governors' Cabinets for the year 2014 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat inzake de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat en de Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs voor het jaar 2014 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34220.s: This omnibus tax bill (Fiscale verzamelwet 2015) makes a series of mostly technical amendments to the income tax, wage tax, corporate tax, dividend tax, VAT, motor vehicle taxes, environmental taxes, excise, customs, and collection laws. It also adjusts several delegation grounds, shifting detailed rules into ministerial regulations and general administrative orders and setting effective dates, including some retroactive ones.
34220.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations mainly as needed for technical detail, transparency, and aligning with EU directives, and in some cases as correcting defective delegation bases.
q: The present adjustments are not intended to bring about any substantive change.
Met de onderhavige aanpassingen wordt geen inhoudelijke wijziging beoogd.
d: Artikel VI, onderdeel B, punt 6 (art. 11 Wet OB 1968)
designating supplies or services excluded from VAT exemptions to prevent distortion of competition
Artikel VI, onderdeel A (art. 8 Wet OB 1968)
rules on VAT matters by or under general administrative order, enabling subdelegation to the minister
Artikel IX, onderdeel B (art. 14 Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag)
number of connections counted for central water supply installations
Artikel IX, onderdeel G (art. 60 Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag)
defining when a consumer is an undertaking in difficulties
Artikel XVI, onderdeel A (art. 4.8 Belastingwet BES)
further rules on valuation increases of immovable property for property tax
Artikel III, onderdeel A (art. 13 Wet LB 1964)
previous delegation for valuation of employer loans, replaced by statutory rule
Artikel I, onderdeel H (art. 4.25 Wet IB 2001)
acquisition price rules for immigrating taxpayers with prior foreign status regarding substantial interests
Artikel VIII, onderdeel B (art. 23 Wet MRB 1994)
additional fuel surcharge conditions for gas-fuelled passenger cars via registry entries
p: Artikel VI, onderdeel B, punten 1-6 (art. 11 Wet OB 1968)
Removes the statutory 'ernstige' threshold for distortion of competition and moves the exclusion of supplies to a ministerial regulation, widening executive discretion over VAT exemptions.
Artikel IX, onderdeel B (art. 14 Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag)
Gives the minister power to set rules on counting connections for central water installations.
Artikel IX, onderdeel G (art. 60 Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag)
Excludes undertakings in difficulties from reduced rates and leaves the definition to a general administrative order.
Artikel XVI, onderdeel A (art. 4.8 Belastingwet BES)
Broadens the wording of the delegation so ministerial rules on valuation increases are less likely to be challenged as exceeding the statutory basis..

parties: Asks how the tightened BPM export refund works and whether further anti-fraud measures are possible.
How exactly is the BPM export refund scheme being tightened? Are further anti-fraud measures still possible, asks the VVD faction.
Hoe wordt de teruggaafregeling BPM exact aangescherpt? Zijn verdere anti-fraude maatregelen nog mogelijk, vragen de leden van de fractie van de VVD.

Welcomes the removal of the interest discount and the BPM anti-fraud change but questions feasibility and asks how the Belastingdienst can verify foreign registrations and whether refunds can be reclaimed.
However, the PvdA faction has questions about feasibility.
Wel hebben de leden van de PvdA-fracties vragen bij de uitvoerbaarheid.
Asks how the Belastingdienst supervises permanent registration of vehicles, the staffing capacity for this, and whether firms in difficulty can be fairly identified.
How does the Tax Authority supervise whether a motor vehicle is permanently registered? How many FTE are available for this?
Hoe ziet de Belastingdienst toe op het al dan niet duurzaam ingeschreven zijn van een motorvoertuig? Hoeveel fte is hiervoor beschikbaar?
Criticises the bill for complicating the tax system and postponing simplification, and questions the legal basis and fairness of the energy tax rule for firms in difficulty.
However, the CDA faction is surprised that the set of measures in the Fiscale verzamelwet mainly makes the tax system more complicated.
Het verbaast de leden van de CDA-fractie echter dat het geheel van maatregelen uit de Fiscale verzamelwet het fiscale stelsel vooral ingewikkelder maakt.
Asks the government to justify the employee-loan change and how the BPM controls and the energy-tax condition operate, including discretion over firms in difficulty.
These members ask whether the government can explain this further and how it fits with the starting point of the work-costs scheme.
Deze leden vragen of de regering dit nader kan toelichten en hoe dit gerijmd moet worden met het uitgangspunt van de werkkostenregeling.
Asks for justification of several changes and reacts to the Nederlandse Orde van Belastingadviseurs' criticism that the BPM measure may be disproportionate and contrary to EU law.
The ChristenUnie faction notes that, according to the Nederlandse Orde van Belastingadviseurs, the proposed anti-abuse measure is disproportionate and therefore contrary to EU law.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie constateren dat de voorgestelde maatregel om misbruik tegen te gaan volgens de Nederlandse Orde van Belastingadviseurs disproportioneel is en daarmee in strijd met het EU-recht is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the Fiscal Omnibus 2015 be sent to parliament but that the BPM export refund restriction needed better justification, effectiveness and drafting. The government's reply explains the scope of the problem, defends the measure against free-movement concerns, and amends the bill's wording and the glasshouse gas tariff condition in line with the advice.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned the size of the problem and whether the BPM refund restriction is effective, since temporary or permanent registration within the EU/EEA can still lead to a refund before export outside it.

The Afdeling considered that restricting the BPM refund could be a barrier to free movement of goods/persons, affecting also regular exports without misuse; the government argued the refund regime exceeds what is strictly required and the change does not hinder free movement.

The reference to vehicle registration documents that comply 'in all respects' with the directive was unclear, and the text should explicitly address temporary documents under Article 1 of the directive; the wording was adjusted to permanent registration.

Verification of the glasshouse business-in-difficulty declaration for the reduced energy tax rate was unclear regarding the state's control role; the government replaced it with a signal-based scheme and an implementing AMvB.
Editorial corrections were made to Article IX G (Wbm art. 60) and Article XX, as recommended in the redactional annex.

34300-IIB.s: The bill sets the 2016 budget appropriations for the Overige Hoge Colleges van Staat and the Cabinets of the Governors, including the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman and Kanselarij Nederlandse Orden. The explanatory memorandum covers budget changes, including the split of the Raad van State into advisory and judicial functions and budget cuts.
q: The Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations is responsible for the availability of a sufficient budget and for managing the budget of the Other High Colleges of State and the Governors' Cabinets.

De Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties is verantwoordelijk voor de beschikbaarheid van een voldoende begroting en verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van de begroting van de Overige Hoge Colleges van Staat en Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs.

34725-I.s: This bill is a supplementary budget adjustment (Slotwet) that amends the 2016 budget statement of the Royal Household (begroting van de Koning I), setting final expenditure, commitment and receipt figures in thousands of euros. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The difference from the estimate is explained by the flow-through of the collective labour agreement for the central government sector into the constitutional allowances.
Het verschil ten opzichte van de raming wordt verklaard door de doorwerking van de cao voor de sector Rijk naar de grondwettelijke uitkeringen.

34725-XVIII.s: This is a supplementary budget (Slotwet) bill that amends the 2016 departmental budget of Housing and Central Government Affairs and the budgets of the related executive agencies, updating appropriations, expenditure and revenue figures to realised amounts. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no explanatory memorandum excerpts, so it leaves the balance between parliament and executive unchanged.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of Housing and Central Government Affairs (XVIII) and the budget statement concerning the agencies, both for the year 2016.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van Wonen en Rijksdienst (XVIII) en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen, alle voor het jaar 2016.

34950-I.s: This is the 2017 closing budget law (Slotwet) amending the State budget for the Royal Household (begrotingsstaat van de Koning), adjusting expenditure and commitments across three non-policy articles to match realised figures. The explanatory memorandum attributes the lower grondwettelijke uitkering to the collective labour agreement for central government staff, which the government says it had projected differently at budget time.
34950-I.j: The memorandum justifies the budget adjustments by pointing to the effect of the collective labour agreement on the constitutional allowances.
q: The difference from the estimate is explained by the effect of the collective labour agreement for the central government sector on the constitutional allowances.
Het verschil ten opzichte van de raming wordt verklaard door de doorwerking van de cao voor de sector Rijk naar de grondwettelijke uitkeringen.

34950-XVIII.s: This bill, a Slotwet, adjusts the 2017 budget statements for the Ministry of Housing and Civil Service (XVIII) and for the executive agencies by recording the final budget changes. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, applying retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that a change to the departmental budget statement of Housing and Civil Service (XVIII) and to the budget statement on the agencies, both for the year 2017, has proven necessary.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van Wonen en Rijksdienst (XVIII) en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen, alle voor het jaar 2017.

35000-V.s: The bill sets the 2019 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs at EUR 9,976.7 million in expenditure and EUR 459.5 million in receipts, expressed in thousands of euros, and makes it effective from 1 January 2019. The explanatory memorandum describes policy priorities such as the International, Impartial and Independent Mechanism on Syria, hosting international organisations, and a schedule of policy reviews.
q: Article 1 The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2019 attached to this law is hereby adopted.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2019 wordt vastgesteld.

35003.s: The bill amends the Wft so that banks must keep an administration that enables the deposit guarantee scheme, and must use the citizen service number (BSN) of depositors for timely payout, contribution calculation and supervision. It also makes non-compliance with the BSN-use obligation subject to DNB enforcement via periodic penalty orders or administrative fines.
35003.j: The memorandum justifies the new BSN-use obligation by the need for timely, error-free payouts and contribution calculations under the deposit guarantee scheme, and reconciles it with privacy rules under Article 10 of the Constitution and the GDPR.
q: It is proposed to express more clearly that the BSN must be used in implementing the deposit guarantee scheme, namely for timely payout, establishing contributions and supervising these.

Voorgesteld wordt beter tot uitdrukking te brengen dat het BSN dient te worden gebruikt bij de uitvoering van het depositogarantiestelsel, namelijk ten behoeve van tijdige uitbetaling, het vaststellen van de bijdragen en het toezicht hierop.
d: ARTIKEL I, A, 1 (art. 3:17, tweede lid, onderdeel d Wft)
rules on the administration needed for the deposit guarantee scheme
p: ARTIKEL I, A, 2 (art. 3:17, zesde lid Wft)

Banks are required to use depositors' BSN for the deposit guarantee administration, with the purpose stated in the statute and supervision by DNB, extending the use of a unique identifier beyond the original payout purpose.
ARTIKEL I, B (bijlagen bij art. 1:79 en 1:80 Wft)
DNB may impose periodic penalty payments or administrative fines on banks for non-compliance with the BSN-use obligation, adding enforcement powers tied to the new provision.

parties: Asks whether the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens' negative advice has really been addressed and how BSN use relates to other BSN uses.
Does the AP share this view and have all objections been addressed, the VVD members ask.
Deelt de AP deze mening en zijn alle bezwaren ondervangen, zo vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie.
Asks about fraud risks from processing BSN of non-customer legal representatives and whether banks will pass on compliance costs to clients.
To what extent will this entail possible fraud risks?
In hoeverre zal dit mogelijke frauderisico's meebrengen?
Supports the bill but asks about alternatives considered and security requirements and oversight for the IKB file.
How is supervision of information security of the IKB file arranged?
Hoe is het toezicht op de informatiebeveiliging van het IKB-bestand geregeld?
Questions the necessity and scope of BSN use, asks how misuse and onward sharing are prevented, and whether the revised text complies with the GDPR as the AP requires.
The AP considers a broad interpretation of BSN use to be in conflict with the GDPR.
De AP acht een ruime opvatting van gebruik van het BSN in strijd met de AVG.
Asks whether the revised bill was resubmitted to the AP and whether the AP still has objections.
The AP lacks an explanation of the necessity of BSN processing in bank administration.
De AP mist namelijk de toelichting op de noodzaak van de BSN-verwerking in de bankadministratie.
Objects to function creep and commercial use of personal data and asks how the government can control secondary use of data.
These members ask the government whether using personal data for commercial purposes is desirable at all.
Deze leden vragen de regering of het gebruiken van persoonsgegevens voor commerciële doeleinden wel wenselijk is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division found no reason for substantive remarks on a bill amending the Wet op het financieel toezicht to regulate use of the citizen service number in the deposit guarantee scheme, and advised sending it to parliament. The minister's reply notes that the bill was amended to allow De Nederlandsche Bank to impose an order subject to penalty or a fine for violations of article 3:17(6).

35012.s: The bill amends the Kieswet to simplify voting from abroad: it removes the 'as soon as possible' wording for sending voting documents, drops the requirement that return envelopes be pre-stamped (stamping only needed when returned by post), removes the list of postal voters, and lets the minister or the mayor of a designated border municipality set up postal voting offices. It also extends the Tijdelijke experimentenwet stembiljetten and centrale stemopneming by one year, to 1 January 2022, with the evaluation date moved to 1 January 2020.
35012.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation power by the need for rapid, detailed rules when local conditions such as hurricanes arise before an election.
q: Such further rules may be needed if local circumstances, such as natural disasters like hurricanes, call for them at the moment a specific election is imminent.
Dergelijke nadere regels kunnen nodig zijn als de plaatselijke omstandigheden, denk aan natuurrampen zoals orkanen, daartoe nopen op het moment dat een specifieke stemming aanstaande is
d: designation of border municipalities for postal voting offices
working procedures of postal voting offices abroad
p: Ministers may, in their judgement, bar voters from being present at postal voting offices abroad when local circumstances make it impossible, subject only to recording this in the minutes.
Procedures for postal voting offices abroad may be set by ministerial regulation, which can be issued at short notice in emergencies.

parties: Asks what the tasks of the border postal voting offices are and how the government will use the discretionary provision, and asks for a broader evaluation of the experiments.
They would like to put some questions to the government.
Graag willen zij de regering enkele vragen stellen.
Argues experiments with elections should not last longer than strictly necessary and asks the government to justify the one-year extension and specify evaluation criteria.
Supports the steps toward easier voting from abroad but wants more ambition and asks why the experiment provisions were not anchored in the Kieswet and why the vooropening period was shortened.
Asks whether using ordinary envelopes for postal votes raises integrity problems and whether postal voting offices can be set up in other countries.
Does this measure not bring integrity problems with it?
Brengt deze maatregel geen integriteitsproblemen met zich mee?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised proceeding with the bill amending the Kieswet to simplify postal voting from abroad, but asked for justification or adjustment on two points: the new polling stations for postal votes in border municipalities (balance between accessibility and integrity) and shortening the pre-opening period for postal votes from 14 to 7 days, which Den Haag objected to. The government's reply (nader rapport) states that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on the balance of access and integrity and on the reasons for not keeping the 14-day period, though the reply itself is only summarized in the text.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to justify the balance between accessibility and integrity of postal voting in the introduction of border-municipality polling stations, which the government addressed by adding a passage on this balance.

The Afdeling asked for justification of shortening the pre-opening period for postal votes from 14 to 7 days, which Den Haag had opposed, and the government added reasons in the explanatory memorandum without changing the proposal.

35030.s: The bill implements the first EU anti-tax-avoidance directive in Dutch corporate tax law by adding a generic interest deduction limitation (earnings stripping), a controlled foreign company (CFC) regime for low-taxed subsidiaries, and related credit and exit-tax payment changes. It takes effect on 1 January 2019, with the exit-tax changes applying to tax debts for which payment deferral is granted on or after that date.
35030.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial designation of low-tax states and the substantial economic activity rules by administrative feasibility and the need to follow the annually published EU list.
q: Each year a comprehensive list of designated states will be set by ministerial regulation based on these criteria.
Jaarlijks zal bij ministeriële regeling een uitputtende lijst worden vastgesteld van de aangewezen staten op basis van deze criteria.
d: Artikel I, C (artikel 13ab, derde lid, onderdeel c)
designation of low-tax states for CFC regime
rules for exit tax payment in installments and administrative obligations
p: The generic interest deduction limitation is applied through assessment by the inspector, who fixes carried-forward interest amounts by appealable decision.
The inspector sets carried-over credit amounts and may revise decisions, with appeal available.

parties: Asks how overlapping anti-abuse rules are avoided and how the government justifies choosing more than the minimum under ATAD 1.
How is it prevented that well-intentioned companies 'drown' in the amount of anti-abuse provisions?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat goedwillende bedrijven «verdrinken» in de hoeveelheid antimisbruikbepalingen?
Supports the measures but asks how the Tax Authority will assess substance criteria and whether it has discretion in practice.
Does the inspector have the freedom in practice, given the amount of profit and activities, to judge that there is insufficient substance even if the payroll and office requirements are met?

Heeft de inspecteur de vrijheid om in de praktijk, gezien de omvang van de winst en de activiteiten, te oordelen dat geen sprake is van voldoende substance als wel voldaan is aan de loonsom- en de kantooreisen?
Welcomes ambition but asks why an open substance norm was not chosen and how the government will monitor effectiveness.
they wonder how this announcement relates to the statements of the State Secretary
zij vragen zich af hoe deze aankondiging zich verhoudt tot de uitspraken van de Staatssecretaris
Argues the government implements the CFC model far more leniently than ATAD 1 requires, weakening anti-avoidance and departing from the Kamer's motion.
The GroenLinks members notice that the government proposes to implement CFC model A of the ATAD 1 directive much more leniently for companies than the ATAD 1 directive prescribes.
Het valt de leden van de fractie van GroenLinks op dat de regering voorstelt CFC-model A van de ATAD 1-richtlijn veel soepeler te implementeren voor bedrijven dan de ATAD 1-richtlijn voorschrijft.
Argues the CFC rules are weaker than the Kamer's motion requested and that the government ignores the motion and consultation, leaving parliament sidelined.
Does the government acknowledge that the proposed CFC rules, given the differences from ATAD 1 CFC rule model A, are much weaker than what the House requested through the Groot motion?
Erkent de regering dat de voorgestelde CFC-regels, gezien de verschillen ten opzichte van ATAD 1 CFC regel model A, veel zwakker zijn dan waar de Kamer om heeft verzocht via de motie Groot 5 ?
Asks how the Groot motion was implemented and why the 7% threshold and payroll criterion were chosen.
This motion requested the government to implement a variant of model A from the directive.
Deze motie verzocht de regering een variant van model A uit de richtlijn te implementeren.
Asks whether the substance requirements are sufficient for large multinationals and how high-risk CFCs will be handled.
In that light, is €100,000, related qualified office staff and renting an office for at least 24 months appropriate for large multinationals?
