Is in dat licht € 100.000, daaraan gelieerd gekwalificeerd kantoorpersoneel en de huur van een kantoorpand voor ten minste 24 maanden dan wel passend voor grote multinationals?
Asks technical questions about criteria for CFCs and the interaction of ATAD 1 with the fiscal unity and bank rules.
Why was fraus legis assumed in implementing ATAD 1 but not in the Parent-Subsidiary Directive in 2015?
Waarom is bij de implementatie van ATAD 1 uitgegaan van fraus legis en bij de Moeder-dochterrichtlijn in 2015 niet?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill implementing ATAD1 should explain its effects on the Dutch fiscal investment climate and motivate why the general anti-abuse rule is not implemented in the Vpb Act, unlike the parallel rule in the Parent-Subsidiary Directive, or else include it. The government's reply states that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on both points and that some drafting corrections were made.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to address the consequences of the robust implementation choices for the Dutch fiscal investment climate; the government placed this within its broader package and added explanation.

The Afdeling asked for a convincing motivation of why the ATAD1 general anti-abuse rule is not implemented in the Vpb Act while the parallel rule in the Parent-Subsidiary Directive was, or else for its inclusion in the law; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on this point.
Drafting corrections were made to the bill and explanatory memorandum, and an omission regarding Dutch permanent establishments of foreign head offices under the earnings stripping rule was repaired.

35102.s: The bill updates quality requirements and inspection oversight in Dutch primary, secondary and special education, reduces administrative reporting duties, and adds statutory bases for inspectorate oversight. It introduces a financial-continuity duty and a Minister power to correct funding for evidently inefficient spending, and allows the inspectorate to designate municipal truancy officers under a cooperation agreement.
35102.j: The memorandum justifies the new funding-correction power by a 2016 Council of State ruling that no statutory basis existed, and says the Minister needs such a power for clearly evident inefficiency, with restraint given school financial autonomy.
q: To provide the missing statutory basis, the provisions on efficiency in the funding decrees are elevated to statute level and included in the sector laws for primary and secondary education.

Om alsnog te voorzien in deze wettelijke basis, worden de bepalingen die zien op doelmatigheid in de Bekostigingsbesluiten naar wetsniveau getild en opgenomen in de sectorwetten van het funderend onderwijs.
d: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel C (artikel 8, achtste lid, WPO)
rules on student monitoring system and related tests
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel BB (artikel 175, derde lid, WPO)
form of ministerial notice of funding correction
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel AA (artikel 171, achtste lid, WPO)
rules on manner and timing of publishing annual report
ARTIKEL VI, onderdeel B (artikel 16a, tweede lid, Leerplichtwet 1969)
Inspectorate may designate municipal truancy officers on municipal request
ARTIKEL VI, onderdeel B (artikel 16a, derde lid, Leerplichtwet 1969)
model cooperation agreement between Inspectorate and municipality
p: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel BB (artikel 175 WPO); ARTIKEL III, onderdeel T; ARTIKEL IX, onderdeel L; ARTIKEL X, onderdeel O

The Minister may investigate school funding and unilaterally correct or withhold funding for unlawful or evidently inefficient spending, subject to written notice and payment rules for upward corrections.
The inspectorate is given a mandated power to withhold up to fifteen percent of a school's funding for violations of the Medezeggenschap law.
Municipal truancy officers may be designated by the Inspectorate to supervise school heads, subject to a cooperation agreement and a rule against role mixing.

parties: Asks how the percentage cap of fifteen percent for withholding funding was derived and what the sanction options are if schools do not publish annual reports.
What is this percentage based on?
Waar is dit percentage op gebaseerd?

Questions whether the open norms on efficient spending and financial continuity are sufficiently clear, whether the inspectorate's judging and advisory roles stay distinct, and whether school boards need broader legal protection against inspection reports.
Is there a danger that because of these open norms the distinction between the inspectorate's judging and advisory role becomes less clear?
Bestaat het gevaar dat vanwege deze open normen dit onderscheid tussen de oordelende en adviserende rol van de inspectie minder duidelijk is?
Asks how supervision can address schools that build up large surpluses through overly cautious budgeting, and whether the inspectorate can assess financial continuity when reserves are large.
Can the inspectorate, in its supervisory and stimulating task, also promote and assess financial continuity when there is a large surplus, these members ask.
Kan de inspectie in haar toezichthoudende en stimulerende taak de financiële continuïteit ook bevorderen en beoordelen als er sprake is van een ruim overschot, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks whether the bill gives tools to reduce unnecessarily high reserves and whether the inspectorate can intervene when very high reserves are held.
Can the inspectorate intervene if very high reserves are held, these members ask.
Kan de inspectie ingrijpen als er erg hoge reserves worden aangehouden, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks whether excessive reserve-building by school boards will be covered by supervision of efficient spending and whether gemeenten are monitored in performing truancy supervision tasks.
Will this problem of unnecessarily hoarding money, so that it does not reach the classroom, also be covered by supervision of the efficient spending of funding?
Wordt ook dit probleem van onnodig geld oppotten, waardoor het niet in de klas terecht komt, meegenomen in het toezicht op de doelmatige besteding van bekostiging?

Asks why no concrete financial continuity norms or categories of clearly inefficient spending were set in law, and questions the strength of the legal basis for supervising efficiency compared with continuity, and the relation between inspectorate sanctions and works council court action.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised the bill on updating funding and quality requirements for primary and secondary education to be sent to parliament only after removing the flexible school week provision (pending a running experiment) and the 'behoorlijke exploitatie' requirement, and narrowing the 'doelmatige besteding' requirement. The minister's nader rapport accepts all these points, removing or narrowing the provisions and adding some technical corrections.
concerns: The Afdeling advised dropping the flexible school week provision until the results of the ongoing experiment are known, since the case for it is not yet evidenced and the effects on education quality are unclear.
The requirement of 'behoorlijke exploitatie' is too vague to serve as a quality requirement and risks encroaching on the school board's own discretion, so it should be dropped.
The concept of 'doelmatige besteding' is too open-ended and must be narrowed to clearly evident inefficient use, given the schools' financial autonomy.

Several redactional and technical corrections were proposed, which the government adopted, except for the advice on applying Aanwijzing 5.36 to the leerplichtambtenaar, which it declined with reasons.

35200-IIB.s: The bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statements of the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden, the Governors' offices of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and the Kiesraad by adopting the final budget (slotwet) with the supplementary budget changes and realised figures. It applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year and sets amounts in thousands of euros.
q: The budget statements forming part of the national budget are, under article 1(3) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, adopted and also amended separately by law.
De begrotingsstaten die onderdeel zijn van de Rijksbegroting, worden op grond van artikel 1, derde lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 afzonderlijk bij de wet vastgesteld en ook gewijzigd.

35210-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statement of the States General (IIA), the first supplementary budget, raising appropriations by about 4.2 million euros in commitments and 33.3 million euros in expenditure across the parliamentary policy articles. It takes effect from 1 June 2019, with retroactive effect if the State Gazette is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment of the budget statement of the States General (IIA) for the year 2019
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal (IIA), voor het jaar 2019

35300-IIA.s: This bill formally establishes the 2020 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Staten-Generaal, setting expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros for the Eerste Kamer, the Tweede Kamer-related allowances, Tweede Kamer operations, and interparliamentary activities. It takes effect on 1 January 2020 and is accompanied by an explanatory memorandum on the parliamentary budget articles.
q: Article 1 The budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2020 is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2020 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the 2020 draft budget bill for the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport notes that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes not included in the text.

35570-J.s: This bill formally establishes the 2021 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds, setting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros and fixing its entry into force. The explanatory memorandum describes budget mutations, an experimentation article under the Deltawet allowing Deltafonds spending on other policy areas, and a transfer of 3.9 million euro to the ILT for cybersecurity supervision.
35570-J.j: The memorandum justifies the experimentation article by saying it serves integrated implementation of the Delta programme and allows integrated financing, conditional on additional funding from other budgets or third parties.
q: The condition is that these measures are connected to flood-safety or freshwater-supply measures and that there is additional financing from other state budgets or third parties.
Voorwaarde is wel dat deze maatregelen samenhangen met maatregelen ten behoeve van waterveiligheid of zoetwatervoorziening en dat er sprake is van additionele financiering

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no substantive objections to the 2021 budget bill for the Deltafonds and only a redactional remark, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts the redactional point and notes that a non-blank opinion on the Finance budget is addressed in an annex.
concerns: The Afdeling suggests deleting the word 'departementale' in article 1 because the Waterwet classifies the Deltafonds as a begrotingsfonds under the Comptabiliteitswet 2016, not a departmental budget.

35850-I.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the King (Eerste suppletoire begroting), raising expenditure commitments and spending on article 2 (functional expenses of the King) by EUR 666 thousand and on article 3 (charged expenditures of other budgets) by EUR 434 thousand, with a EUR 268 thousand receipt. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 June 2021.
q: We Willem-Alexander, by the grace of God, King of the Netherlands, Prince of Orange-Nassau, etc.
Wij Willem-Alexander, bij de gratie Gods, Koning der Nederlanden, Prins van Oranje-Nassau, enz.

35975-A.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (second supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditure and revenue lines across road, rail, waterway, mega-project and exploration items. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amended statement effective the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2021.
q: We Willem-Alexander, by the grace of God, King of the Netherlands, Prince of Orange-Nassau
Wij Willem-Alexander, bij de gratie Gods, Koning der Nederlanden, Prins van Oranje-Nassau

36002.s: This omnibus bill makes numerous technical amendments across health-ministry laws (alcohol, medicines, subsidies, ambulance care, tribunal procedures, medical research, healthcare registration) to fix omissions and align cross-references. It mainly adjusts delegation grounds, clarifies procedural rules and deadlines, and corrects drafting errors, with no major transfer of power to the executive.
36002.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to correct omissions, allow practical adjustments, and align procedures with the experiment and new regulations.
q: Amendment of the Alcohol Act in connection with the National Prevention Agreement and evaluation of the law
Het Nationaal Preventieakkoord en evaluatie van de wet
d: exemptions for minors serving alcohol in education
stock continuity and marketing obligations for holders of marketing authorisation
ARTIKEL VI (Wet experiment gesloten coffeeshopketen, art. 7 lid 1)
details of implementing the coffeeshop experiment, now also by ministerial regulation
deadline and timing for publishing annual accounts of care providers
maximum tariffs for ethics committee review fees
deadlines for providing documents for certificate of competence
ARTIKEL XXIV (Wet BIG ingevoegd lid, aanwijzing en toelichting) / ARTIKEL XXVI
entry into force by royal decree, varying per article
p: ARTIKEL II, onderdeel D (Alcoholwet, art. 44 lid 1)
Mayor may withdraw a shop's right to sell low-alcohol drink after three violations within twelve months at the same location, with discretion to decline.
ARTIKEL XIII, onderdeel D en E (Wet BIG, art. 73 en 73a)
Complainants gain an appeal against inadmissibility decisions and the appeal-decision deadline is extended from thirty days to six weeks, strengthening legal protection.

parties: Asks how remote 'drogist op afstand' supervision could adequately prevent misuse of UAD medicines.
To what extent is it possible, according to the government, to adequately supervise improper use of UAD medicines via a remote 'druggist'?
In hoeverre is het volgens de regering mogelijk om via een «drogist op afstand» voldoende toezicht te houden op oneigenlijk gebruik van Uitsluitend Apotheek en Drogist (UAD)-geneesmiddelen?
Asks why the article 62 change is treated as technical rather than policy, whether stakeholders were consulted, and how safe consumer use is ensured.
Can the government explain why it was chosen to treat this change as a technical change rather than a policy change?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom ervoor gekozen is om deze wijziging als een technische wijziging te behandelen en niet als een beleidsmatige wijziging?
Follows the government's reasoning but raises concerns about patient safety, the KNMP's warnings, and vulnerable groups who cannot use digital advice.
What is the government's view on digital information provision in relation to selling UAD medicines to these vulnerable groups?
Wat is de opvatting van de regering over deze ontwikkeling van digitale informatievoorziening in relatie tot de verkoop van UAD-geneesmiddelen aan deze kwetsbare groepen?
Fears the change blurs the line between UAD and general medicines and creates tension between commercial interests and care quality.
Does the government acknowledge that this change sets in motion a slippery slope?
Erkent de regering dat met deze wijziging een glijdende schaal wordt ingezet?
Questions why a substantive change sits in an omnibus bill, asks which partners were consulted, and worries about patient safety and supervisory capacity.
Is it not such a substantive proposal that it should be treated separately?
Is het niet een zodanig inhoudelijk voorstel dat deze apart behandeld dient te worden?
Asks that the article 62 change be treated as substantive, that relevant stakeholders be consulted, and that physical and online sales be clearly separated in law.
therefore requests the government to consult all relevant field parties and seek alignment with them
verzoekt de regering dan ook om alle relevante veldpartijen te consulteren en afstemming met hen te zoeken
Asks how consumers know where to get advice and whether the CBG will monitor and set criteria for classifying self-care medicines as UAD or UA.
How does the consumer know where he or she could turn with questions?
Hoe weet de consument waar hij of zij met vragen terecht zou kunnen?
Asks how health risks of selling UAD medicines without physical presence are weighed, whether each of 3000 medicines is assessed, and why no consultation of field parties took place.
Can the government indicate how these health risks are weighed against the intended objective of the amendment?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe deze gezondheidsrisico’s worden afgewogen tegen de beoogde doelstelling van de wetswijziging?
Questions whether removing the druggist requirement is a mere technical change, whether enforcement and monitoring are feasible, and whether the government should set care requirements in law.
Does the government not think it has a responsibility toward citizens to include care requirements in the law?
Vindt de regering niet dat zij een verantwoordelijkheid heeft richting de burger om zorgvuldigheidseisen in de wet op te nemen?
Worries that remote advice lets patients underestimate risks and interactions, and that people with low digital or language skills will lack adequate advice.
They therefore ask the government to explain whether, and if so how, this will be sufficiently guaranteed after the introduction of this bill.
Daarom vragen zij de regering om toe te lichten of, en zo ja hoe, dit na de invoering van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel voldoende gewaarborgd zal zijn.

Asks whether UAD medicines should be re-examined for misuse risks and interactions, under what conditions remote sales must occur, and how active information provision is guaranteed without a druggist.
Has the government considered this and/or does it see possibilities to supervise this?
Heeft de regering daarover nagedacht en/of ziet de regering mogelijkheden om hier toezicht op te houden?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Verzamelwet VWS 2022 without remarks and recommended submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport then explains seven technical amendments added to the bill, including corrections to the WMO fee and contact-person provisions and removal of a fining power in the Zorgverzekeringswet.

36011.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate by adding 400 million euros to the expenditure ceiling of policy article 2 (business innovation and entrepreneurship), as a third incidental supplementary budget for extending the KKC and GO-C schemes in the first half of 2022. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 17 January 2022, with retroactive effect where the gazette is published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate for the year 2022 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36100-IIB.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement (IIB) for 2021 for the other High Colleges of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, adjusting appropriations and receipts per article and setting out the realised figures. It also fixes the budget in thousands of euros and gives the amendment retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the other High Colleges of State, Governors' Cabinets and the Electoral Council (IIB) for 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.

De departementale begrotingsstaat van de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat, Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs en de Kiesraad (IIB) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36200-IIA.s: This bill sets the 2023 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Staten-Generaal (IIA), with total expenditure and receipts in thousands of euros, and enters into force on 1 January 2023. The explanatory memorandum describes the budgetary lines for the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and joint interparliamentary activities.
q: The budget statement for the year 2023 belonging to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2023 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on 12 September 2022 that it had no objections to the 2023 budget bills (blanco adviezen) and recommended submission to parliament. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport of 19 September 2022 transmits this and notes that some budgets require amendments, provided in annexes.

36435-I.s: The bill amends the departmental budget statement of the King (I) for 2023 through a supplementary budget submitted on Prinsjesdag. It changes budget lines for functional expenditure and cross-charged expenditure, with no changes to the constitutional allowance article.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the King (I) for the year 2023
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van van de Koning (I) voor het jaar 2023

36470-J.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds (J) to reflect the second supplementary budget for 2023, reallocating appropriations and expenditure across Deltafonds articles. It is a budgetary adjustment with no new delegated rule-making powers or changes to oversight.
36470-J.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by delays in project realisation and shifts of funds to 2024, not by any claimed need for new executive powers.
q: For this reason it was decided to give the water boards an extra year to be able to draw on the first tranche.
Om deze reden is besloten om de waterschappen een jaar extra te geven om een beroep te kunnen doen op 1 e tranche.

36550-K.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (first supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across materiel, infrastructure and IT lines in thousands of euros. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 1 June 2024.
q: The first supplementary budget gives an overview of financial deviations from the draft budget of the DMF and is submitted together with the Spring Memorandum and published no later than 1 June.

De eerste suppletoire begroting geeft een totaaloverzicht van financiële afwijkingen ten opzichte van de ontwerpbegroting van het DMF en wordt tegelijk met de Voorjaarsnota ingediend en uiterlijk 1 juni gepubliceerd.

36560-J.s: This bill (Slotwet Deltafonds 2023) adopts the final budget statements of the Deltafonds for 2023, changing spending and commitment figures to match the realised amounts. The explanatory memorandum says only technical execution, bookkeeping and audit-driven changes are included, with no new executive powers.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping changes or changes arising from audit findings.
– In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevin dingen opgenomen;

36613-K.s: The bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) for the second time, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across the defence materiel articles and transferring funds from other budget chapters. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment retroactive to 17 September 2024.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) for the year 2024
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) voor het jaar 2024

36740-J.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds, adjusting appropriations, expenditure and receipts across its articles via a supplementary Slotwet. It contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive, and its technical budget adjustments are reported as the final accounting for the year.
q: The budget statement of the Deltafonds (J) for the year 2024 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds (J) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36800-M.s: The bill formally fixes the 2026 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Klimaatfonds, the climate fund, at 480.063 thousand euros in commitments and expenditure across energy infrastructure, early-stage scale-up, industry decarbonisation, and buildings. The explanatory memorandum sets out multi-year climate fund spending tables across several ministries, but the bill itself delegates no rule-making power and does not alter oversight or judicial review.
q: Article 1: The budget statement attached to this law regarding the budget fund for the year 2026 is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat inzake het begrotingsfonds voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division had no remarks on the 2026 budget bill for the Klimaatfonds (M) and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport notes that some budgets require amendments and refers to annexes, without specifying changes to the Klimaatfonds bill.

36820-K.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget schedule of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K), with a first supplementary budget and a September supplementary budget that change spending and revenue amounts across defence materiel categories. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law retroactive to 17 September 2025.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget schedule of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) voor het jaar 2025

36820-XXIII.s: The bill amends the 2025 departmental budget of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth through a supplementary budget (suppletoire begroting september), raising commitments by about 23 billion euros and cutting expenditure by about 335 million euros. It sets the budget figures, makes the change effective the day after publication and gives it retroactive effect to 16 September 2025.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth (XXIII) for the year 2025 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei (XXIII) voor het jaar 2025 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36945-C.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), setting the commitment amounts for the general grant at €3.714 billion and for integration and decentralisation grants at €0 and €403.6 million respectively. It also records the supplementary budget changes, realised figures and closing differences for the 2025 fiscal year, with effect from the day after publication.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant is set for the 2025 grant year at €3,714,685,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2025 vastgesteld op € 3.714.685.000.
